tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgya cher 'grel pa 'phags mchog rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/

oṃ swā sti/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po'i rgya cher 'grel pa 'phags mchog rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'phags pa kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po'i don cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de la 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam thams cad yongs su 'dus pa smon lam gyi mdo chen po yin pa'i phyir/ tshigs bcad 'di nyid logs su phyung ba mdo sde rang rkang tshugs pa zhig tu yang 'gyur la/ spyir ni 'phags pa sangs rgyas phal po che las/ 'phags pa sdong pos brgyan pa'am/ 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rab 'byams mtha' yas ston pa zhig ste/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rtog pa las/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde mchog tu bsngags so/ /mdo sde de nyid kyi mjug gi cha la gnas pa las smon lam 'di phyung ba'o/ /logs su bzhugs pa la mdo sde rang rkang tshugs par 'gyur ba dang*/ tshig de nyid mdo sde rgyas pa gzhan gyi nang na yod pa yang mi 'gal te/ 'phags pa tshigs bcad gcig pa dang*/ 'phags pa rten 'brel snying po dang*/ sher phyin brgya lnga bcu pa dang*/ sgo nyer lnga pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud du mar snang ba bzhin no/ /de yang spy-ir sdong po bkod pa yongs rdzogs kyi dbang du byas na ni 'byam klas pa zhig yod pa las/ deng sang 'dzam bu'i gling du spyod pa 'di ni/ nor bzang gis dge ba'i gshes gnyen bsten tshul phyogs gcig pa ste/ 'on kyang 'di kho na'i don tsam yang gzhal bar dka'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag pa'i sa la gnas nges pa zhig tshong dpon gyi khye'u'i tshul bzung ba/ nor bzang zhes bya ba zhig gis/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal nas byams pa'i bar gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten te/ mthar dpag tshad brgya rtsa bcu'i pha rol nas 'jam dpal gyis phyag brkyang ba/

grong khyer yid bde ba mngon du gyur pa zhes bya ba na nor bzang yod pa'i spyi bor bzhag ste ched du brjod pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang ye shes kyi spyod yul mtha' yas pa thob pa/ 'jam dpal gyi byin rlabs kyis kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug nus par byin gyis brlabs shing*/ rdo rje rin po che padma'i gdan la bzhag ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi seng ge'i khri la mngon du phyogs par 'dug go /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa kun tu bzang po mthong bar 'gyur ba'i ltas ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa bcu tshan gnyis nor bzang gis mthong ngo*/ /de nas 'phags pa kun tu bzang po nyid mthong na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob pa dang 'dra bar sems pa las/ skad cig de nyid la ye shes mtha' yas pa 'phel bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyang mngon sum du mthong*/ de'i spyan snga na byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang mthong ngo*/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid rjes su thob pa de yang rin chen padma'i khri la bzhugs pa mthong ste/ de'i ba spu'i khung bu re re nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'od zer gyi sprin mang po thon nas/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa snang bar byas te/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed pa la sogs pa rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i cho 'phrul chen po nyi shu lhag cig mthong ngo*/ /de nas nor bzang yid dga' ba dang bde ba skyes nas/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sku lus kyi cha shas rnam par phye nas/ mthar ba spu'i khung bu gcig la yang*/ dbus su mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams dang bcas pa'i phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bkod pa mtha' dag dang de dag kyang*/

bskal pa chags pa dang 'jig pa'i bar gyi tshul rnams ma lus pa/ gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du mthong ngo*/ /skabs 'di na 'dod pa'i khams kyi yul dang bcas/ gzugs kyi khams kyi yul dang bcas/ gzugs med pa'i khams kyi yul dang bcas/ gzhi dang bcas/ rten dang bcas/ dbyibs dang bcas/ zhes 'byung zhing*/ gzhan yang phal po che 'dir/ gzugs med khams la snod kyi 'jig rten yod pa'i tshigs yang dang yang du 'byung bas/ gzugs med ces pa dman pa la dgag pa'i sgra'o/ /kun tu bzang po de'i mtshan bzang po re re la yang sngon gyi mtha' mur thug pa'i bar gyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams dang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yang bstan/ phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar gyi yang bstan/ sangs rgyas re re'i drung na kun tu bzang po re re yang 'dug de dag gi lus re re la yang dus gsum du byung ba'i shes bya thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan yang mngon par bstan par mthong*/ de nas kun tu bzang po nyid kyis da lta rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' yas pas 'gro ba'i don spyod tshul dang*/ sangs rgyas mnyes par byed tshul/ de dag gi rgyur sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mtha' yas pa spyad tshul gsungs te/ sangs rgyas rnam snang gi spyan snga na bzhugs pa'i kun tu bzang pos phyag brkyang ste nor bzang gi spyi bor bzhag pa'i tshe/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i/ sangs rgyas re re'i zhabs 'bring na yang kun tu bzang po re re bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yas pa'ang*/ nor bzang gi spyi bor bzhag par gyur cing*/ chos kyi sgo mang po sna tshogs la zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rnam 'phrul de la brten pa'i zhu lan cung zad mdzad nas/ rnam 'phrul de lta bu'i rgyu spyod pa mtha' yas pa spyad tshul rnams gsungs te/ nga'i lus rnam par dag pa la ltos shig gsungs nas/

kun tu bzang po'i ba spu'i khung bu re rer yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston pa la sogs pa mtha' yas pa'ang mthong*/ kun tu bzang po'i gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa yang thos nas/ de'i sku lus kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du zhugs nas/ sems can smin par byed par gyur la/ de nas nor bzang rang nyid kyis kyang rnam par thar ba mtha' yas pa de thob nas/ de lta bu ston par gyur to/ /de'i rjes su 'di skad ces/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos bskal pa dang*/ bskal pa rgya mtsho 'byams klas pa dang*/ 'jig ten gyi khams gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul phra rab snyed po de dag brnan te mngon par brjod pa'i phyir/ tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis smon lam btab pa/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ sogs 'byung ngo*/ /'di ni zhing khams rnam par dag par byed pa dang*/ rnam par thar ba mtha' yas pa de lta bu thob par bya ba'i phyir/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang smon lam 'di lta bu gdab dgos so zhes pa dang*/ 'di'i don bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa de ni/ rnam par thar ba 'di la gdon mi za bar 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /zhes go bar bya ba'i phyir te/ de yang bskal pa dang bskal pa zhes lan gnyis zlos pa ni/ mang po'i sgra yin la/ bskal pa de tsam du phyogs bcu'i zhing khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa rnams re re bzhin yang bskal pa rgya mtsho 'byams klas pa'i bar du chags 'jig gi rim pas spel zhing brgyud nas byung ba/ de tsam gyi zhing khams thams cad yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir du/

de thams cad stong pa nyid dang snying rje dang thabs la mkhas pa'i ye shes gcig gi ngo bor blos yang yang bsdoms pa na sbyangs min legs par grub cing zhing khams la dbang 'byor ba thob pa ni brnan te zhes pa'i don yin no/ /'di la kun tu bzang po'i smon lam zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos gsungs ba'am/ bdag gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa thob pas kun tu mdzes pa dang*/ skyon thams cad bral bas kun tu kun nas bzang pa'i phyir sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chus sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyi ming yin la/ smon lam 'di la yang byang chub kyi spyod pa thams cad 'dus pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas byang sems kun gyi smon lam mo/ /yang bzang po spyod pa zhes bya ba ni kun tu bzang po spyod pa'i dbang du byas pa dang*/ yang na bzang po yang yin la spyod pa yang yin pa ni bzang po spyod pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa/ thog mar thos pa'i dus na dge/ bar du bsam bsgom gyi dus na'ang dge/ mthar 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i dus na'ang dge ba'o/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu'i sa pa ste/ rdzi bo lta bur sems bskyed pa'i smon lam zhes kyang zer ro/ /gzhung dngos bshad pa la/ dpal phyogs kyi glang po'i 'grel pa las yan lag bdun po re re nas bgrang ba dang*/ bsngo ba'i rab dbye dang*/ de'i mtha' dang*/ phan yon te don gyi rnam grangs bcu'i bsdus don mdzad do/ / 'dir 'di skad ces byas na bzung sla bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyud dag par bya ba yan lag bdun pa/ dngos gzhi smon lam gyi rab dbye/ smon lam gyi mtha' dang phan yon bstan pa/ phan yon can gyi smon lam nyid bsngo ba ste don bzhi las/ dang po la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa bya ba dang*/ nyes pa bshags pa dang*/ bsod nams la yi rangs ba dang*/ chos 'khor bskor ba dang*/ bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba ste bdun no/ /dang po phyag 'tshal ba la/

mdor bstan pa ni/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge gang*/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ji snyed na su dag bzhugs pa zhes sbyar te/ 'jig rten khams gcig gam/ bcu la sogs pa'i grangs tshad can ma yin par/ phyogs bcu'i mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang da ltar bzhugs pa kho nar ma zad kyi/ dus gsum du gshegs pa ste/ gshegs pa'i don byung ba yin pas/ sngar byung zin pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba dang*/ ma 'ongs pa 'byung 'gyur thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /su zhig gis phyag 'tshal zhe na/ bdag gis so/ / phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi khyad par dang ldan pa su la phyag 'tshal zhe na/ mi'i seng ge ni sangs rgyas/ kun te mang po/ ma lus pa ste mtha' dag go /de dag thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshul ji ltar phyag 'tshal na/ gzhan gyis bskul ba sogs ma yin par/ rab tu dang ba ste dang ba chen po'i sgo nas lus dang ngag dang yid gsum car gyi phyag bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /ci'i phyir sangs rgyas la mi yi seng ge zhes bya na/ seng ge ni ri dwags thams cad zil gyis gnon cing bag tsha ba med pa ltar mi'i skye bar yang ston la/ bdud dang phyir rgol ba sogs/ lha mi thams cad zil gyis gnon cing*/ rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs dang 'phrin las bya ba la bag tsha ba med pa'o/ /mang po la phyag 'tshal ba'i dgos pa ci snyam na/ sangs rgyas gcig la phyag byas pa'i bsod nams yang mtha' yas na sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa la phyag 'tshal ba'i bsod nams gzhal du med pa las kyang ches gzhal du med pa'o/ /rgyas bshad la gsum las lus kyi phyag 'tshal ba ni/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/

/bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam ni/ bzang po spyod pa la smon pa ste/ spyod pa de la 'dun pa'i stobs dag gis/ rgyal ba ste sangs rgyas mngon sum du mthong bar nus kyang rung mi mthong na yang ste/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus thams cad yid kyis mos pas mngon sum du dmigs te/ de re re'i sku mdun du yang rang gi lus zhing ste 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul ji snyed yod pa de snyed du sprul te/ lus de dag thams cad rab tu btud pa ste/ thal mo sbyar zhing yan lag lnga sa la gtugs pa yis/ rgyal ba sangs rgyas kun la rab tu'am shin tu ste/ dus mtha' yas par yang nas yang du'am rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rnams la ci'i phyir rgyal ba zhes bya na/ mdo las/ sdig pa mi dge'i chos las nga brgyal te/ /de phyir nyer 'gro nga ni rgyal ba yin/ /ces so/ /lus mang pos phyag 'tshal bar mos pa'i dgos pa yang*/ las gcig tu 'du shes pas phyag btsal ba yang phan yon che na/ mtha' yas par mos pas lta ci smos pa'o/ /gnyis pa yid kyi phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ rdul phra rab gcig gi steng ste go sa na yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa'i rdul gyi grangs ji snyed pa de snyed dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas rnams bzhugs pa dang*/ de yang gcir ba dang dog pa ma yin par/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang rang gi sras te byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ mchod pa'i bkod pa sogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas te/ zhing khams kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag yin la/ rdul gcig na yod pa de bzhin du/ chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyis ji ltar khyab pa de ltar rdul gyis khyab pa thams cad du yang*/ phyogs thams cad rgyal ba mang po dag gis gang bar mos te/

de dag la yid kyis dad pa bla na med pa sgom mo/ /de la sangs rgyas zhes pa ni/ ma rigs pa thams cad sangs shing mkhyen pa thams cad rgyas pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sras zhes bya ba ni/ chos las skyes pa'i sras so/ /de ni sems dang po bskyed pa yan chad kyang yin la/ yang na 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ sa dang po thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang sku gsung thugs rnam pa 'dra bar gyur pa'i don no/ /rdul gcig tu sangs rgyas mang po bzhugs pa sogs ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi rdul la de ltar snang ba dang*/ las dang po pas ni mos pa yid byed kho nar zad do/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyi spyod yul yang de dang 'dra mod kyi/ ye shes kyi snang ba kho na yin pas/ phyi rol gyi rdul lam/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul tsam la gnas shing mi spyod de/ rdul dang spyod yul de dag ni don dam pa'i ye shes kyi ngor med pa'i phyir ro/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis khyab tshad du 'jog pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings kyis ma khyab pa mi srid pa'i don te/ nam mkhas gar khyab tu de ltar snang ba yin mod/ de yang kun tu bzang po'i smon lam 'di/ yongs su grub pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la snang ba ni yin la/ smon lam de yang sa dang po nas dngos su'am rab tu sgrub cing*/ sa brgyad pa nas ni legs par grub pa yin par shes so/ /yang nges pa'i don mthar thug pa na/ ye shes nyid la chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor du mngon sum du snang ba yin te/ de ltar na 'di ni bde gshegs snying po mkha' mnyam yin pas/ sa bcu pa thob pa yan chad kyi spyod yul yin te/ de man chad kyi byang chub sems dpa' la ni mos pa'i yul du bya ba tsam mo/ /'on kyang las dang po pas/

de lta bu la dad par byas pas 'bras bu mtha' yas pa ni 'byung ngo*/ /gsum pa ngag gi phyag 'tshal ba ni/ de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas de dag bstod par bgyi zhes pa ni/ gnyis pa'i don la dang po ste de dag la bstod par bgyi ba'o/ /yid kyi yul du ji ltar byas pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la/ bstod cing bsngags pa yon tan rgya mtsho zad mi shes pa rnams brjod pa'i sgo thams cad nas bstod pa'i tshul yang mi zad pa rgya mtsho lta bu rnams/ ngag gis brjod tshul phun sum tshogs pa dbyings kyi yan lag lnga la sogs pa yan lag ste snyan pa la sogs pa'i khyad par mtha' yas pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i sgra skad de lha mo dbyangs can ma'i ngag bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i sgo nas rgyal ba thams cad kun gyi yon tan rab tu brjod cing ste brjod pa'i tshul gyis/ bde bar gshegs pa de dag thams cad la bdag gis bstod par bgyi'o/ /de yang chos dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas re re'i drung du/ lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul pa dang*/ lus de lta bus sangs rgyas re re'i zhabs la 'dud cing*/ lus re re la yang mgo de snyed dang*/ mgo bo re re la yang lce'i rtse mo de snyed dang*/ lce de snyed las kyang bstod dbyangs de snyed 'byung bar mos pa'o/ /yang bshad pa'i rnam grangs gzhan rgya mtsho zhes smos pa rnams/ rgya mtsho lta bu'i dpe don du mi sbyor bar/ grangs kyi gnas rgya mtsho zhes bya ba rgya skad sa mu dri'i sgra las/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mtsho yas su bsgyur pa de'o/ /de ni gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum sa ya bye ba dung phyur ther 'bum rnams dang*/ shwa rngog dang mchog nyal dang*/ rkyang 'phyes dang*/

bye ba nab nub dang*/ mtsho yas zhes 'jig rten tu bgrangs pa ltar yin no/ /zhes kyang bshad de 'on kyang dpe don du sbyor ba kho na 'thad do/ /gnyis pa la bla na yod pa'i mchod pa dang*/ bla na med pa'i mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*/ /sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*/ /mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis/ / rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*/ /phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*/ /bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la yang mchod par bgyi/ /de la dam pa zhes pa rnams dang*/ mchog ces pa rnams kyis don ni/ bzang po'i don te/ dngos po de dang de yang rgyu bzang ba/ kha dog dang dbyibs mdzes pa/ gzhan yang sgra dri ro reg phun sum tshogs pa dang bkod pa legs pa la sogs pa'o/ /des na sna tshogs pa'i me tog bzang po dang*/ rin po che dang me tog gi dra ba sogs phreng ba dam pa dang*/ sil snyan te rol mo'i bye brag rgyud can dang*/ 'bud dkrol dang brdung bya sna tshogs pa sgra snyan pa rnams dang*/ dri zhim po'i byug pa rnams dang*/ gdugs mchog la sogs pa ba dan dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ lda ldi la sogs pa'o/ /mar me la sogs pa snang gsal gyi mchog mtha' yas pa dang*/ sbyar ba dang ma sbyar ba'i dri zhim po sreg pa'i bdug spos dam pa rnams kyis/ gang mngon sum dang yid kyi spyod yul du dmigs pa'i rgyal ba de dag la ni nyin re bzhin du yang mchod par bgyi'o/ /bar 'dir rgya dpe 'ga' zhig las byung ba/ phyis kyi lo tsā ba kha cig gis bsgyur ba na/ rin chen mchog dang do shal mchog rnams dang*/ /rnam bkra lha rdzas bla re mchog rnams dang*/ /rgyal mtshan mchog dang ba dan mchog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la yang mchod par bgyi/ /zhes pa yang snang ba sngon gyi 'grel pa rnams las mi 'byung zhing*/

bod dpe rnying pa kun la yang med la/ deng sang su yang mi 'don pa'i phyir 'dir yang bshad pa ma bris te go ni sla'o/ /lha dang mi las byung ba'i na bza' dam pa rnams dang*/ chag chag gis btab pa dang*/ mchod yon dang*/ gong bu'i rdzas dri zhim mchog rnams dang*/ dri bzang gi bye ma'i phur ma te thum por byas pa rnams pa sna tshogs spungs pa'i phung po ri rab dang mnyam pa dang mchod pa de dag thams cad kyang bkod pa mdzes pas khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis/ rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi'o/ /dngos su smos pa de dag ni mtshon pa tsam te/ 'jig rten du ji tsam yod pa de tsam du mchod pa bzang pa dang bkod pa legs pa thams cad/ dngos su bshams pa dang yid kyis sprul pa'i tshul gyis 'bul ba yin no/ /gnyis pa bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ /bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /mchod pa gang bgyis pa rnams bla na med pa ste lha'i 'jig rten man chad na/ de bas lhag pa lta ci smos/ de dang mnyam pa 'ga' yang med pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' mthu thob pa rnams kyis byas pa'i mchod pa'o/ /de yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pas rgya che ba yin la/ mchod pa de dag gong du smos pa'i rgyal ba thams cad la yang*/ lhag par mos pa bla na med pa'i dad pa dang*/ bzang po spyod pa la phan yon dpag tu med pa zhig yod par yid ches pa'i dad pa stobs kyis kun nas blangs pas/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod par bgyi'o/ /de ltar na phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di dag dngos su sgrub mi nus pas ni mos pas sgrub pa dang*/ ma 'ong pa na de lta bu 'grub par smon lam 'debs pa nyid don gyi gtso bo yin te/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/

/zhes dang*/ bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yang yin no/ / yang mdo las/ tshangs pa gsum po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba bla na med pa'o/ /mchod pa'i las bla na med pa'i bsod nams tshad med pa 'byung ngo*/ /gsum gang zhe na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos 'dzin pa dang*/ ji ltar thos pa'i chos rnams de bzhin du sgrub pa'o/ /zhes bla na med pa'i mchod pa de gsum du bshad la/ 'dir yang sangs rgyas la mos pa dang*/ bzang po'i spyod pa la dad pa gnyis bla na med pa'i mchod pa'i khyad chos su bshad de/ gnad gcig go /gsum pa ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis na/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*/ /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /de la nyes pa'i rgyu ni dug gsum ste/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis kun nas blangs pa'i dbang gis na'o/ /nyes pa'i gzhi ni lus dang ngag dang de bzhin du yid kyis kyang bgyis pa ste/ srog gcod pa la sogs pa ni lus kyis so/ /rdzun la sogs pa ni ngag gis so/ /gnod sems la sogs pa ni yid kyis so/ /byed pa po ni bdag gis bgyis pa zhes pa'o/ /bshags pa dngos ni/ de lta bu'i sdig pa ci mchis pa ste gang yod pa de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags par bgyi'o/ /su zhig gi spyan sngar zhe na/ rdul gcig steng na zhes sogs su ji skad bstan pa ltar/ sangs rgyas sras bcas mtha' yas pa rnams kyi spyan sngar ro/ /de la ma bshags pa'i nyes pa ni/ sngar byas la 'gyod pa med pas/ sdig pa la rung bar 'dzin pa na/ sdig pa'i rgyun de nyid 'phel bar 'gyur zhing*/ phyin chad mi sdom pas las ngan pa zad pa med par 'gyur ro/ /de las ngan song du brgyud mar 'gro ste thar pa lta ci smos mtho ris kyang thob par dka'o/

/sdig pa bshags pa'i phan yon ni/ 'gyod cing bshags pa kho nas sngar gyi rgyun mi 'phel zhing byang bar yang 'gyur la/ phyin chad 'dzem zhing zlog pas mi dge ba rgyun chad de/ ngan 'gro las zlog cing mtho ris su 'gyur ba dang*/ dge ba'i sa bon brtas te thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur yang 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na rgyal ba sangs rgyas kun dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ rang rgyal rnams dang*/ nyan thos la/ slob pa rgyun zhugs dang*/ phyir 'ong ba dang*/ phyir mi 'ong gsum dang*/ mi slob pa dgra bcom pa dang*/ 'gro ba ni 'gro ba drug gi so so skye bo rnams kyi/ bsod nams te/ dge ba ci dang ci bgyis pa gang la yang*/ de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang bar bgyi'o/ /de la yi rang ba ni rab tu dga' ba yin la/ rjes su zhes pa ni gang dang gang gis bya ba byas pa'am 'bras bu thob pa'i gnas skabs de la/ slar yang dmigs nas 'jug pa ni/ sngar song pa de'i rjes su zhugs pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir bsod nams zhes pa/ bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i las gsum du phye ba'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi zlas drangs pa'i bsod nams sogs yod kyang*/ 'dir ni dge ba'i chos thams cad do/ /bshags pa dang yi rang ba 'di dag la/ dge ba'am sdig pa rang gi bgyis pa dang*/ gzhan bgyid du brtsal ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bya ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ de dang de'i bsngags pa brjod cing bstod pa rnams kyang*/ bshags pa dang rjes su yi rang bar bya ste/ 'on kyang bshags bya'i sdig pa ni rang gis byas pa gtso bo yin la/ yi rang gi yul ni gtso bor gzhan gyi dge ba'o/

/rang gis bgyis pa'i dge ba la yang*/ 'gyod na dge ba mi 'phel la/ nga rgyal med cing dga' ba bsgoms na dge ba 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba ni/ gzhan gyi dge ba bri ba yang med la/ rang gi rtsol ba med cing ma byas kyang*/ dge ba chen po rgyud la thob par 'gyur bas/ smad du byung ba'i dge ba yin la/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa chos kyi dbyings mngon sum du rtogs shing*/ ji snyed pa thams cad la yang gsal snang thob pa dag gis ni/ rang gis dmigs pa'i yul du gsal bar snang ba'i 'jig rten gyi dge ba ji tsam pa de tsam de dang de la yi rang bas kyang thob par 'gyur te/ dper na stong sum cu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams kyi bskal pa brgya'i bar du byas pa'i dge ba rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags gcig gi mngon shes kyis thams cad ma 'dres par gsal ba snang bar mthong la/ de thams cad la gcig car du dmigs pa med pa'i yi rang thun gcig tsam bsgoms pas kyang*/ sems can de rnams kyis dus de tsam du bsags pa'i dge ba de snyed cig yi rang de'i mthu las skad cig de la byang chub sems dpa' de'i rgyud la thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du mtha' med pa'i bar du yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /de la 'dod pa'i khams kyi sems can ni mnyam par ma bzhag pa yin la/ gzugs kyi khams pa ni bsam gtan bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ gzugs med khams pa yang gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa kho na'o/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi 'phags pa lhag bcas thams cad ni lus kyi rten khams gsum du gtogs pa yin mod kyi/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa rnams kyi sems kyi rten ni/ khams gsum las 'das pa kho na yin la/ slob pa rnams kyi sems kyang*/ khams gsum gyi sems dang bcas pa yin gyi/ sems rgyud gyi ngo bo gang 'phags pa'i rgyud du gyur pa'i cha de ni/

khams gsum las 'das pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /dgra bcom pa lhag med kyi yid lus dang*/ lhag bcas kyi dbang po'i lus dang*/ theg chen 'phags pa rnams kyi ni/ lus kyang khams gsum las 'das na sems lta smos kyang ci dgos/ /de ltar na khams gsum du gtogs pa'i so so skye bo la yang*/ lam du zhugs pa dang ma zhugs pa gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir lam zhugs rnams ni/ byang chub sems dpa' dang slob pa'i khongs su bsdus te/ 'gro ba kun ces pa ni lam du ma zhugs pa kho na'i dbang du byas pa'i khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad do/ /nyan thos tshogs lam pa dang sbyor lam pa rnams ni/ nyan thos 'phags pa slob pa'i rgyu nye ba yin pas/ de'i khongs su gtogs par dgongs te ma smos pa dang*/ rang rgyal gyi tshogs lam la gnas pa yang de dang 'dra la/ sbyor lam pa dang 'phags pa slob pa'ang cung zad yod mod kyi/ yun thung bar dgongs nas slob pa zur du ma smos so/ /de la gang zag gi bdag med pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bden pa bzhi'i don mngon sum du rtogs pa ni 'phags pa yin la/ ma rtogs pa ni so so skye bo'o/ /nyan thos kyi tshogs sbyor gyi rtogs pa sngon du song nas/ bden pa bzhi'i don mngon sum gyis mthong bas/ khams gsum du gtog pa'i nyon mongs kyi nang nas lta ba ngan pa dang the tshom la sogs pa mthong spangs kyi char gyur pa rnams ni spangs mod kyang*/ spyir khams gsum du gtogs pa'i nyon mongs ma spangs pa de ni rgyun du zhugs pa zhes bya la/ 'dis ma spangs pa'i nyon mongs de dag la/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba zhes bya zhing*/ de'i nang gi 'dod khams su gtogs pa'i nyon mongs sum gnyis ni spangs/ sum cha lus pa na 'phags pa phyir 'ong zhes bya'o/ /'dod khams su gtogs pa'i nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa na/ 'phags pa phyir mi 'ong ba zhes bya'o/ /'di la sgom spangs su gtogs pa gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams kyi nyon mongs ci yang ma spangs pa dang*/

cung zad spangs pa nas/ phal cher spangs pa'i bar du rtogs pa mtho dman sna tshogs pa yod do/ /khams gsum du gtogs pa'i nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa ni dgra bcom pa'o/ /de yang myur ba srid pa gsum gyis mthar zhes pa ltar/ nyung mtha' yang skye ba gsum du tshogs bsags pa las 'byung la/ skye ba gsum la lam lnga sbyor tshul bshad kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges so/ /rgyun zhugs sogs bzhi po de gang zag gcig gis rim can kho nar mngon du byed pa'ang yod/ bar ba gnyis med par sgom spang khams gsum gyi nyon mongs rnams chab gcig tu spong pa'i rigs can thogs mtha' gnyis kho na mngon du byed pa'ang yod/ so so skye bo'i dus na 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis bsam gtan gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa rnams ni/ nam bden pa mthong ba na phyir mi 'ong du 'gyur bas 'bras bu phyi ma gnyis kho na mngon du byed pa sogs sna tshogs pa yod de/ de dag ni nyan thos 'phags pa yin no/ /rang rgyal ni bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags pa sngon du 'gro ba yin yang*/ gnas skabs de dag tu phal cher tshogs lam la gnas pa yin la/ sbyor mthong sgom gsum mnyam gzhag thun gcig la bgrod par byas nas/ de'i bar ma chad pa la zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa ste/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu dang mthar phyin pa'i lam mngon du byed pa ni/ rang rgyal gyi gtso bo bse ru lta bu yin la/ tshogs la spyod pa'i rang rgyal la ni de ltar ma nges te/ 'on kyang thams cad mthun par sngon gyi skye bar sangs rgyas la bya ba byas shing*/ nyan thos lam la slob pa rnams dang 'dra bar byas pa yin yang*/ lhag por rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba la ches mkhas par byas pa dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis srid pa tha ma'i gnas skabs su sangs rgyas mi bzhugs shing*/ /ston pa med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su/ bla ma med par rang gi bag chags kyi stobs sad pa kho nas/

byang chub mngon du byed pa'o/ /nyan thos 'phags pa la ni dbang po rno brtul sna tshogs yod la/ 'di ni dbang rnon kho na'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ste bsod nams kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa bsags te/ byang chub tu smon lam btab theg pa chen po la thos bsam sgom gsum du byas pas tshogs kyi lam du yang yon tan du ma thob la/ sbyor ba'i lam du gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa 'phag mchog rnams dang rjes mthun pa grub cing*/ ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs dang mngon shes mtha' yas pa'ang bsgrubs nas/ mthong lam du chos nyid spros bral rnam pa thams cad pa'i don mngon du byas pas/ bden bzhi'i don sogs nyan rang gi spangs rtogs thams cad zhor la thob cing*/ byang sems 'phags par gyur pa zhes bya la/ de nyid kyi rgyun las dang po nas bcu pa'i bar du yon tan mtha' yas pa gong 'phel thob pa de dag ni/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhes bya ste/ de ltar na dbye ba 'di dag mngon pa sogs gsung rab gzhan shes pa dag la skabs 'dir bshad mi dgos kyang shin tu las dang po dag la go ba phyogs tsam mtshon pa'i phyir/ zur tsam smos pa'o/ /rnam par dbye ba mtha' yas pa ni dus ji snyed par yang brjod par mi nus te/ 'phags pa rnams kyis so sor rang gis rig par bya ba nyid pas/ gzhung rgya chen po smra ba rnams kyis 'chad tshul mang po'i sgo nas/ dka' ba du ma dang bcas te 'chad mod kyang*/ rgya mtsho chen po las skra rtse gcig gis blangs pa'i chu thig gi tshad tsam yang ma yin no/ /spros pas chog go lnga pa ni/ gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul/ /gang sangs rgyas rnams zhes spyir smos te/ de yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams na/ sems can gti mug gi mun par 'khyams pa rnams la lam ston par mdzad pas/

'jig rten gyi sgron mar gyur pa sangs rgyas rnams byang chub sgrub par byed pa'i lam gyi rim pa/ lam lnga dang sa bcu la sogs pa'i rim pa ma lus par sngon du song bas/ bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma chags ma thogs par brnyes pa'am/ yang na de ltar lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thob kyang*/ thob pa de la zhan pa mi mnga' bas ma chags pa'i mgon po sangs rgyas de dag thams cad la bdag gis 'khor lo bla na med pa ste/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /'khor lo ni shing rta'i 'khor lo lta bu ste/ ngo bo brtan pa'i dngos po yin yang*/ rang gi gzugs kyi 'phrul gyis/ pha rol gyi gnas su phyin par byed pa dang 'dra bar/ nyon mongs pa sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis mi shigs par gnas pa shin tu brtan pa chos kyi lam ston pa po'i rgyud la mnga' ba de/ nyan pa po'i rgyud la 'phos pa dang 'dra bar rtogs pa bskyed nus pa ni chos kyi 'khor lo'o/ /bla na med pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa yin pa dang*/ lha dang drang srong rnams kyis bstan pa'i chos dang thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /bskul ma 'debs pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku sangs rgyas nas ring po ma lon pa/ da ltar 'jig rten du chos 'khor ye ma bskor ba la/ chos 'khor spyi ldog nas bskor bar gsol ba 'debs pa ste/ spyir chos 'khor bskor bzhin pa yin yang*/ skabs su babs pa de dang de'i chos gsung bar gsol ba 'debs pa'ang 'di'i khongs su bsdu'o/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje can zang zing la chags pa dang mi mkhyen pa mi mnga' bas/ mi dgos so snyam na/ chos la gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir bskul dgos pa'ang yin la/ gtso bor ni sangs rgyas chos mi gsung bar mi srid kyang*/ rang gi blo sems can la snying brtse ba'i phyir tshogs bsags pa'i slad du blo'i rim pa sbyangs tshul lo/ /drug pa ni/ mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/

/'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*/ / bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /don dam par na/ sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' mod/ mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan pas 'dul ba rnams la yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par gang bzhed pa de dag la/ dgos pa sangs rgyas 'jig rten du bzhugs na phan bde mtha' yas pa lhun grub tu 'byung ba nyid yin pas/ 'gro ba kun la 'phral du phan par 'gyur zhing yun du bde ba'i phyir du/ dus kyi khyad par bskal pa chen po phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhing khams kyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed du bzhugs par yang gsol ba 'debs pa po bdag gis gsol ba 'debs te ji ltar 'debs pa'i tshul ni/ thal mo rab tu sbyar bas gsol ba 'debs par bgyi'o/ /'phral du bde ba ni 'byor ba dang*/ dbang phyug la sogs pa dang yun du phan pa ni mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*/ /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /gong du smos pa ltar/ yul mchog la lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa rnam pa gnyis kyis mchod pa/ stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ skye 'phags kyi dge ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul zhing*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol ba ste/ yan lag drug po de byas pa lus byung ba'i dge ba cung zad bdag gis gang dang ci bsags pa de dag thams cad ces pa ste/ dngos su ni de tsam yin yang rang gis dus gsum du dge ba byas pa dang byed du bcug pa dang*/ yi rang dang*/ bsngags pa brjod pa thams cad dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad kyang*/ blos gcig tu bsdoms nas bsngo dgos te/

de dag thams cad kyang chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa nyid du byas nas so/ /cung zad dad ci bsags pa zhes pa'i tshig gis kyang zur gyis 'phangs pa yin no/ /bsngo rgyu'i dge ba de rnams gang du bsngo zhe na/ byang chub chen po bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi phyir bsngo'o/ /sus bsngo bar byed ce na bdag gis so/ /gal te byang chub mchog tu ma bsngos na/ rang rang gi 'bras bu phyung nas zad par 'gyur te/ 'khor ba pa rnams kyi ni bde 'gro tshun du zad la/ nyan rang gi de dag kyang lhag med kyi dbyings su zad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas su bsngos na ni/ de ma thob kyi bar du yang lha mi'i bde skyid sogs bde ba gong 'phel du 'gyur zhing*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob zin nas/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa brnyes pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' ji srid pa'i bar du gnas shing*/ sems can thams cad kyi don spyod pas bsod nams kyi 'bras bu nam yang zad pa mi srid pa yin no/ /bsngo ba de yang*/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bsngags pa'i bsngo ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa sogs su las/ sbyin pa de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas/ bla na med pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar byed de yongs su bsngos pa na/ ci nas mtshan mar yang dag par yongs su mi mthong ba ste/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis yongs su bsngo bar byed de/ bdag gis ci zhig sbyin par byed/ su zhig sbyin par byed/ ci zhig yongs su bsngo bar bya/ su zhig yongs su bsngo bar byed/ gang du bsngos na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pa'i dngos po de/ yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo*/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na nang stong pa nyid kyis stong pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/

stong nyid rnams la rim gyis sbyar nas/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /des gang du yongs su bsngo bar 'gyur/ ci zhig yongs su bsngo bar 'gyur/ gang gis yongs su bsngo bar 'gyur/ zhes de ltar mthong ste/ de ltar yongs su bsngos na legs par yongs su bsngos par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ bsngo ba'i yul bla na med pa'i byang chub dang*/ ched du bya ba gzhan don kho na dang*/ yid la byed pa'i rnam pa ni/ bsngo bya'i dge ba 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa dang*/ bsngo ba nyid kyang 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa ste/ khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i bsngo ba yin no/ /yongs su bsngo ba'i khyad par rgyas pa ni/ 'phags pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i le'u las rtogs par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa smon lam gyi rab dbye la/ dpal phyogs kyi glang po la sogs pa sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis don tshan rnam pa bcu drug tu mdzad do/ /de yang sdom ni/ lhag bsam byang sems mi brjed dang*/ /ma gos phan bde go cha dang*/ /skal mnyam 'grogs dang bshes gnyen bsten/ /sangs rgyas mngon gyur dam chos 'dzin/ /mi zad mdzod thob 'jug pa dang*/ /stobs dang sgrub pa las dang ni/ /rjes su slob dang 'jug sdud do/ /de yang bsam pa dag pa'i sgo nas smon pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i sgo nas smon pa dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te ma gos pa'i sbyor ba'i dang*/ gzhan la phan bde'i dang*/ go cha bgos pa'i dang*/ skal mnyam dang 'grogs pa'i dang*/ bshes gnyen bsten pa'i dang*/ sangs rgyas mngon gyur gyi dang*/ dam chos yongs bzung gi dang*/ mi zad pa'i mdzod thob pa'i dang*/ 'jug pa du ma'i dang*/ stobs kyi dang*/ gnyen po bsgrub pa'i dang*/ las kyi dang*/ rjes su slob pa'i dang*/ thams cad kyi don bsdu ba'i sgo nas smon pa'i smon lam rnams so/ /dang po bsam pa dag pa'i sgo nas smon pa ni/

'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang zhes pa nas/ re ba'ang 'grub par shog gi bar yin la/ de la'ang don tshan bzhi las/ sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i bsam pa ni 'das pa'i sogs/ dgongs pa yongs su bskang ba'i ni/ gang yang ma byon sogs/ zhing yongs su dag pa'i ni/ phyogs bcu'i ga la'i sogs/ sems can la phan gdags pa'i bsam pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i sems can sogs so/ /gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa la/ byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing*/ /zhes pa nas/ yongs su byang bar shog gi bar te/ tshe rabs sogs kyis rtag tu rab tu 'byung ba dang*/ tshul khrims spyod pa sogs kyis tshul khrims dag pa dang*/ lha'i sogs kyis skad sna tshogs pas chos ston pa dang*/ des shing sogs kyis dge ba la brtson pa dang*/ rgyu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa dang*/ sdig pa sogs kyis de'i mi mthun phyogs spong bar ston to/ /yang na 'di la tshe rabs dran pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba so sor phye nas/ rgyu lngar byas kyang legs par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ma lus pa'i sbyor ba'am ma chags pa ni/ las dang zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /bzhi pa gzhan la phan bde ni/ zhing gi khyon dang sogs so/ /lnga pa go cha bgo ba ni/ byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*/ /sogs te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rdzogs pa dang*/ sems can gyi spyod pa dang mthun par 'jug pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos ston pa gsum la rim pas sbyar ro/ /drug pa skal mnyam gyi grogs dang 'grogs pa ni/ bdag gi spyod dang sogs so/ /bdun pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing mnyes par byed pa ni/ bdag la phan par sogs so/ /brgyad pa sangs rgyas mngon gyur la mchod pa sogs bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas sras kyi sogs te/ 'khor dang dus dang bsam pa skyo ba med pa dang*/ mchod pa ste don tshan bzhi rim can du sbyar ro/ /dgu pa dam chos yongs su bzung ba ni rgyal ba rnams kyi sogs te/

chos 'dzin pa dang ston pa dang*/ rab tu sbyor ba gsum rim gyis so/ /bcu pa mi zad pa'i mdzod thob par bya ba ni/ srid pa thams cad sogs te/ tshogs gnyis dang mthu thob par bya ba'o/ /bcu gcig pa 'jug pa du ma'i sgo nas smon pa ni/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhes pa nas/ drung du bdag mchi'o bar ro/ /de la 'jug pa brgyad ste/ dang po zhing dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas lta ba la 'jug pa ni/ rdul gcig sogs/ gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung la 'jug pa ni/ gsung gcig yan lag sogs/ gsum pa chos 'khor bskor ba la 'jug pa ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa sogs/ bzhi pa bskal pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa ni/ ma 'ongs bskal pa sogs/ lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa blta ba la 'jug pa ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa sogs/ drug pa de'i spyod yul la 'jug pa ni/ rtag tu de dag sogs/ bdun pa zhing sgrub pa la 'jug pa ni/ gang yang dus gsum sogs/ brgyad pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du 'gro ba la 'jug pa ni/ gang yang ma byon sogs so/ /'dir sdom ni/ zhing blta gsung dang chos 'khor dang*/ /bskal pa sangs rgyas spyod yul dang*/ /zhing sgrub pa dang drung du 'gro/ /'jug pa brgyad du shes pa yin/ spyi don bcu gnyis pa stobs kyi sgo nas smon pa ni/ kun tu myur ba'i nas/ yang dag sgrub par byed kyi bar ro/ /bcu gsum pa bsgrub pa'am gnyen po'i sgo nas smon pa ni/ las kyi stobs rnams sogs te/ las nyon bdud gsum 'joms pa dang*/ gnyen po dngos te don tshan bzhi rim can dang*/ bcu bzhi pa 'phrin las kyi sgo nas smon pa ni/ zhing rnams rgya mtsho nas mi skyo spyad par bgyi zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di la yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa dang*/ sems can smin par byed pa dang*/ chos rtogs pa dang*/ rjes thob kyi ye shes thob pa dang*/ spyod pa mtha' yas pa dang*/ smon lam rdzogs pa dang*/ mchod pa sgrub pa dang*/

bskal pa mtha' med par 'jug pa ste don brgyad rim can no/ /bco lnga pa rjes su slob pa ni/ gang yang dus gsum sogs te/ 'di la sangs rgyas kyi rjes su slob pa dang*/ sems dpa' chen po'i rjes su slob pa'o/ /bcu drug pa don bsdu ba'i bsngo ba bstan pa ni/ spyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig /sogs so/ /de ltar na bsdus pa'i don gyi rim pa 'di ni/ rgya 'grel phal cher gyi bshad pa mgrin gcig pa yang yin la/ khyad par mkhan po ye shes sde'i zhal lnga nas ji skad gsungs pa ltar bkod pa yin no/ /de bas na bsdus don 'di ni shin tu khungs che ba'i phyir/ 'di la gces spras su bya zhing mi nub pa'i don du bkod pa'o/ /shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel par ni don tshan bcu drug po spyi tsam nas 'dra ba las/ dang po la byang chub tu sems bskyed pa zhes ming 'dogs pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa sogs don tshan bcu rim pa bzhin mos spyod kyi sa'i phar phyin bcu dang sbyor zhing*/ mchod par gyur ces pas sbyin pa dang*/ padmo dang*/ nyi zla'i dpes chags sdang gis ma gos pa dang*/ grang dro'i bya ba byed kyang*/ chags sdang gi rnam rtog med pas bzod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mngon du 'gyur bas smon lam gyi stobs yin pa sogs rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas 'chad la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing lta ba la sogs pas 'jug pa brgyad kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa lta ba'i 'jug pa dang*/ de'i spyod yul la 'jug pa gcig tu bsdoms nas gzhung tshan bdun po de sa dang po rab tu dga' ba sogs lhag bsam dag pa'am ma dag sa bdun la rim gyis sbyor ba dang*/ don tshan bcu gnyis pa stobs kyi smon pa sa brgyad pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa la mi mthun phyogs nyams zhes zer te sa dgu pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa la yon tan yongs su sbyong zhes 'dogs pa dang*/ bco lnga pa rjes su slob pa la gnyis su phye nas/ gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yi/

/zhes sogs la yon tan thams cad rdzogs par bya ba zhes gsung zhing*/ rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyis/ tshogs gnyis bzung bas byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rjes su slob pa ste don tshan bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa bsdoms pas sa bcu pa bshad cing*/ sa bcu bstan pas 'phags lam gyi phar phyin bcu yang bshad pa dang*/ bcu drug pa thams cad kyi don bsdus ni kun tu 'od kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su smon lam 'debs pa'o/ /zhes bzhed de legs par bshad pa'ang yod la/ ji bzhin mi 'byor ba yang 'ga' re snang ngo*/ /'on kyang sngon gyi dus 'phags pa'i yul du theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rnam par dag pa dang por yod pa'i gnas skabs su legs par grags pa'i mkhas pas bshad pa yin pas na/ 'dir yang lugs de go ba'i phyir rnam grangs su cung zad blangs pa'o/ /'on kyang 'dir bshad sla zhing go bde ba'i phyir/ bsdus don gzhan gyi sgo nas brjod na/ 'di la mdor bstan rgyas bshad don bsdus gsum las/ dang po ni/ tshigs bcad gsum ste/ gsungs pa/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par gyur/ /gang yang ma byon de dag rab myur bar/ /bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas spyon/ /sngon byon pa 'das pa'i sangs rgyas su rab tu grags pa rnams dang*/ da ltar phyogs bcu yi 'jig rten gyi khams dag na gang 'gro ba'i don la bzhugs pa thams cad la/ mchod pa'i bye brag thams cad kyis mchod par gyur cig gang yang ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas te/ 'og min du sangs rgyas zin nas/ gdul bya dus la ma babs par/ 'jig rten du sprul pa'i sku mi ston pa rnams sam/ myur du 'tshang rgya bar rung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag rnams/ dka' ba dang 'bad rtsol med bzhin du/ rab tu myur bar rang rang gi dgongs pa'i bsam pa rdzogs nas/

dus la bab ste/ dga' ldan du skye ba ston pa la sogs pa/ byang chub mngon du brnyes pa'i rim pa tshul dang mthun par bstan nas/ sangs rgya bar spyon cig ste shog cig pa'o/ /de yang 'og min du sangs rgyas zin pa rnams/ so so'i gdul bya smin pa sogs dgongs pa myur du rdzogs nas sprul sku myur du 'byon par shog cig pa dang*/ sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi dgongs pa'i bsam pa tshogs gnyis kyi lhag ma myur du rdzogs nas/ sangs rgyas brnyes par gyur cig pa ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems chen po de rnams kyi smon lam rdzogs par bsngo ba yin la/ de dag gi phyir du rang gi smon lam rdzogs par yang bya dgos pas mchod pa dang bskul ba 'di gnyis ni/ rang gzhan gyi smon lam nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir du smon lam 'debs pa'o/ /yang gsungs pa/ phyogs bcu ga la'i zhing rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rgya cher yongs su dag par gyur/ /byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs rgyal ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas sras kyis rab tu gang bar shog /phyogs bcu'i ga la ba'i ma dag pa'i zhing ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bde ba can gyi zhing bzhin du mchog tu rgya che zhing*/ ngan song la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad dang bral nas/ yongs su dag par gyur cig zhing khams de thams cad kyang shing gi rnam pa thams cad kyi/ rab dang mchog dang gtso bo mthar thug pa yin pa'i phyir/ shing gi dbang po ste byang chub kyi shing gi drung du gshegs te/ mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas zin pa'i rgyal ba dang*/ de dag gi 'khor du sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod pa dang*/ sems can mtha' yas pa dge ba la 'god par mdzad pa rnams kyis rab tu gang bar shog cig pa ste/ snod dang bcud dag par smon pa tshig rkang gnyis gnyis so/ /de ni zhing yongs su sbyong ba'i smon lam mo/ /yang gsungs pa/

phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur/ /'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni/ /mthun par gyur cing re ba'ang 'grub par shog /phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rtag tu nad kyi rigs mtha' dag spangs shing med la/ ngan song gsum dang*/ mtho ris kyi sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral zhing*/ 'dod yon dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur la/ 'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don te mtho ris dang thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i spyod pa rnams byas pa la/ phan tshun thams cad blo gros mthun par 'gyur zhing*/ chos dang mi 'gal pa'i re ba'i don thams cad kyang 'grub par shog cig re ba'i don gyi mthar thug pa ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub yin par 'gyur te/ sems can thams cad kyang rang nyid bde ba dam pa thob par 'dod pa yin na/ bde ba dam pa mthar thug pa ni/ de las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas tshun chad kyi yang*/ re smon gyi gnas ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub yin par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na dngos su smon par mi byed kyang 'dod pa'i tshul la dpag nas bsgrub na de ltar rigs shing 'grub pa yin no/ /de dag ni sems can yongs su smon par byed pa'i smon lam ste/ mdor bstan 'dis ni rdzogs smin sbyang gsum tshang bar bstan cing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad dam/ smon lam gyi yul thams cad gsum po der 'dus pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ theg pa chen po'i spyod pa thun mong ba'i rim pa dang sbyar ba'i smon lam dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas pa'i smon lam dang*/ gnyis kar du 'jug pa'i rnam grangs sna tshogs pa bstan pa'i smon lam mo/ /dang po ni/ byang chub spyod pa dag ni nas/ kun tu spyod par gyur ces pa'i bar te/

de la byang chub spyod pa ni/ gzhan don du bdag nyid bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phyir du spyod pa ste/ bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos rdzogs pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i ldog cha 'dzin la/ bzang po spyod pa ni sems can gzhan rnams kho na sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jog pa'i phyir spyod pa ste sems can gzhan smin cing grol bar byed pa'i rgyu'i ldog cha 'dzin pa yin cing*/ gnyis ka yang snying rje chen po dang 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis kun nas blangs pa'i/ sbyin sogs phar phyin bcu/ thabs mkhas phun sum tshogs pas zin pas/ rang rgyud grol zhing gzhan rgyud smin par byed pa la ni 'dra'o/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' gcig kho nas kyang*/ spyod pa gnyis kar spyad dgos te/ sems can gyi don du gang rlabs che ba/ skabs su gang bab pa de nyid la 'jug dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang*/ sems bskyed pa dang po'i gnas skabs kyi smon lam gyi khyad par las/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dod chen pa dang*/ 'dod chen pa ma yin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byang chub spyod pa pa ste/ thog mar bdag nyid sangs rgyas su gyur nas 'khor ba srid kyi bar gzhan don byed pa/ rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i byang sems zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems can gcig kyang ma lus par/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la ma bzhag gi bar du/ sems can kho na sgrol ba'i phyir/ bdag nyid 'khor ba na gnas par bya yi/ 'tshang rgya bar ma gyur cig ces smon lam 'debs pa ni/ bzang po spyod pa pa ste rdzi bo lta bu'i sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i byangachub sems dpa' 'o/ /de bas na de gnyis sems dang po bskyed pa'i smon lam dang 'dun pa'i khyad par yin gyis/ bar du spyod pa ni gnyis kar spyod la/ mthar 'bras bu la yang khyad par med do/ /'o na byang chub spyod pa pa ni/ 'phags pa byams pa bzhin du 'jig rten na 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur la/

bzang po spyod pa pa ni kun tu bzang po dang 'jam dpal la sogs pa bzhin du/ tshogs rdzogs kyang dam bca' ma rdzogs pas mngon par sangs mi rgya ba ste/ 'bras bu rigs gnyis yod pa ma yin nam snyam na/ tshogs rdzogs nas sangs mi rgya ba ni mi srid de/ sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa de nyid sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sngon gyi dam bca' dang smon lam yang*/ blo sbyong pa'i phyir yin gyi/ dmigs yul dngos po la zhugs pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ mthar phyin par spyod dgos pa yang ma yin no/ /kun tu bzang po dang 'jam dpal la sogs pa/ zhing khams kun tu byang chub sems dpar snang ba yang*/ byang chub sems dpar 'dul ba la de ltar bstan pa yin gyi/ gnas tshul ma yin la/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i zhing khams mang por sangs rgyas nyid du yang bstan zin cing ston bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyal ba byams pa la sogs pa bzhin zhing 'dir sangs rgyas su ston pa rnams kyang*/ zhing gzhan dang gnas skabs gzhan du byang chub sems dpas 'dul ba la slar yang byang chub sems dpar 'byung ste/ 'o skol gyi ston pa bskal pa mtha' yas pa'i sngon rol tu sangs rgyas zin pa yang*/ phyi nas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun mi chad par bstan pa bzhin no/ /de bas na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rtsa ba'i zhing dang sku lus 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing du longs spyod rdzogs sku yin na/ gang tshogs gnyis rdzogs tshad de ma thag tu zhing der longs sku'i rten du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gdon mi za la/ ma dag pa'i zhing du sprul pa ston pa la ni/ sangs rgyas dang sems dpa' chen po gnyis su yang 'byung mod kyi/ der ma zad sprul pa mtha' yas pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ngo*/ /des na 'jam dpal la sogs pa sngon gyi dam bca' mi 'dor ba'i phyir/ da dung sangs ma rgyas so zhes gsungs pa ltar yod srid na'ang*/

dgos pa bzang po spyod pa dang 'brel ba'i dam bca' yang dag pa la/ gdul bya rnams spro ba skye zhing 'god nus pa'i dgos pa yod par gzigs pa dang*/ dgongs gzhi byang chub sems dpas 'dul ba'i ngor byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin pa yang*/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba la dgongs so/ /gzhan du na tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs mi rgya ba zhig srid na ni de'i rgyu gang yin/ sgrib pa'i cha cung zad bzung bas so snyam na/ sa bcu pa'i ye shes kyis 'bad rtsol med par/ yun thung ngus kyang sgrib pa mtha' dag spong bar 'gyur na yun ring po de nyid kyis ci'i phyir spang par mi 'gyur/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin yang tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir mi thob pa mi srid la/ des sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas par spong bar mi 'gyur na ni/ sangs rgyas gzhan rnams kyis kyang thams cad mkhyen pa la sgrib pa mi spangs par yang 'gyur la/ des de spong na sgrib pa ci zhig lus par 'gyur/ gzhan yang tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sgrib pa lus pa yang mi srid de/ nyi ma shar bas mun pa bzhin no/ /tshogs ma rdzogs pa yang mi srid de/ dus mtha' yas par gzhan rnams las kyang lhag par spyod pa rgya che ba rtag tu spyad pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal la sogs pas sgrib pa'i cha cung zad gzung ba ltar bshad pa yod du chug kyang*/ gdul bya 'ga' zhig la snang tshul byung ba la dgongs pa'i drang don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /shin tu spros pas chog go /de bas na/ gzhung 'dir byang chub spyod pa dang*/ bzang po spyod pa zhes pa rnams de ltar nges par byas nas/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ skye ba dran pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba dang*/ spyod pa spyi la slob pa dang*/ khyad par du tshul khrims la slob pa dang*/ mngon shes dang ldan pas chos ston pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa rnams la bslabs pas/ sgrib pa mtha' dag byang ba dang*/ skyon gsum las grol zhing*/

chags pa med pa'i gnas thob pa na/ sems can rnams sdug bsngal zhi zhing bde ba dang dge ba la 'god par byed/ khyad par du mtha' yas pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa thob nas/ chos bstan pas 'gro ba'i don mtha' med du spyod pa 'gyur ro zhes pa ni/ lam gyi rim pa dang po 'di'i skabs kyi bsdus pa'i don yin te/ de dang mthun par smon lam 'debs pa'o/ /sdom ni/ sems bskyed skye ba dran dang rab tu byung*/ /spyod pa spyi dang tshul khrims mngon shes ston/ /byang sems mi brjed sgrib byang skyon gsum grol/ / chags med zhi bder 'god dang rnam 'phrul thob/ /'gro don spyod de don tshan bcu gsum yin/ /ces so/ don tshan dang po gsum ni/ byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing*/ /'gro ba kun tu skye ba dran par gyur/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba na/ /rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar shog /ces gsungs te/ byang chub spyod pa gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod cing*/ byang chub kyi phyir du pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod par 'dod pa'i sems skyed blangs shing*/ de dang mthun pa'i spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing*/ de las 'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba'i gnas kun las/ gar skyes kyang rung ste/ rtag tu skye ba dran pas sngon sems bskyed pa dang*/ chos spyad pa yang dran par gyur la/ tshe rabs kun gyi gnas skabs su ni/ 'chi 'pho ba dang skye bas bsdus pa'i skye ba bzung zhing gson pa'i gnas skabs thams cad na/ dus rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar shog cig 'dir rab tu byung ba ni gnyis te/ so so skye bo'i gnas skabs su khyim spangs te rab tu byung nas sdom pa yang dag par blangs bas rab byung du 'gyur ba dang*/ theg chen 'di la 'phags pa'i sa thob tshad chos nyid kyi rab byung thob pa'o/ /don tshan bzhi pa dang lnga pa spyod pa spyi dang tshul khrims la bslab pa ni/

rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*/ /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag pa/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog /ces te/ de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum du mjal ba'am lkog tu gyur kyang gsung rab thos pa la brten nas/ rgyal ba sangs rgyas kun gyi gdams ngag chos las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar/ rjes su slob par gyur te/ bzang po spyod pa'i rgyu'am sgrub pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug la yang dag par bslab pas yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i thabs la 'jug par byed cing*/ khyad par du byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims rnam pa gsum gyi spyod pa/ nyon mongs spangs pas dri ma med la/ rang don theg pa dman pa'i sems kyis ma gos pas yongs su dag pa/ 'chal tshul ltung pa'i nyes pas rtag tu ma gos pas ma nyams pa/ dus gsum gyi dngos po thob par sred pa med pa'am/ bden dngos su 'dzin pa dang bral bas skyon med pa ste/ de lta bu'i tshul khrims la spyod par shog cig /don tshan drug pa mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pas chos ston pa ni/ lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang*/ /'gro ba kun gyi skad rnams ji tsam par/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to/ /byang chub sems dpa' mthu thob pa'i dbang du byas nas/ lha'i skad dang*/ klu'i skad dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi skad dang*/ grul bum la sogs pa dag gi skad dang*/ mi'i skad tha dad sna tshogs rnams kyi skad dang*/ de dag la sogs pa 'gro ba kun gyi sgra skad rnams ji tsam yod pa de tsam thams cad kyi skad du/ bdag gis chos bstan to ste ston par gyur cig pa'o/ /de yang*/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes kyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ mngon shes de'i mthu ni thag ring ba dang shin tu phra ba sogs lkog tu gyur pa'i sgra thams cad kyang shes/

'gro ba tha dad pa'i skad rnams dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i sgra rnams kyang go rang gi skad dang ngag tshig gcig gis kyang sems can gzhan rnams la de dang de'i skad sna tshogs pa so sor go bar nus pa'o/ /de bas na/ lha la lha'i skad dang*/ klu la klu'i skad la sogs pa dus gcig gam rim can du ston par nus so/ /'dir lha ni 'dod pa'i lha rigs drug go /klu ni brang 'gro sbrul gyi ming yin yang*/ de rnams kyi nang nas rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams la/ spyi ming bye brag la btags pa'i tshul te/ 'phags pa'i yul du klu'i lha'am/ /bod kyi brda rnying pa rnams la klu 'brug tu grags pa'o/ /gnod sbyin ni rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs kyi lha rnams la'ang grags mod kyis 'dir lha las logs su bkar ba'i phyir/ bar snang la rgyu ba'am sa steng du rgyu ba'i mdangs 'phrog pa po rnams so/ /grul bum ni gshin rje'i rigs su gtogs pa yi dwags kyi 'gro ba'i khyad par ram/ gdugs pa'i sems can no/ /bdun pa byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa ni/ des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtson te/ /byang chub sems ni nam yang brjed ma gyur/ /des pa ni mdzangs pa ste/ ngang tshul 'jam pa'am/ mkhas la zhib pa'i blo ste/ des par bgyis shing*/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la skyo ba med par ngang gis 'jug pa'i rab tu brtson pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ba ni rnam pa gnyis te/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la 'god par 'dod pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes la mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du nam yang brjed par ma gyur cig ces pa'o/ /de la des pa ni rgyud 'jam pa'i phyir snying rje mi brjed pa dang*/ mkhas pa'i phyir stong nyid mi brjed pa ste rgyu'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa la ngang gis brtson pa yang de rnams mi brjed pa ste yan lag go

/de yang gzhan gyis ma bstan par sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la 'jug pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad rnams 'di dag tu 'dus pa yin te/ de yang mos spyod kyi sa la ni ci rigs par thob cing*/ 'phags pa'i sa la ni rdzogs par thob pa'o/ /de dag kyang 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las gsungs te/ ma bstan par pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 'jug pa ste drug dang*/ ma bstan par bsdu dngos dang thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ theg pa mchog gi 'byung ba zhes pa ste gsum dang*/ theg chen las ma nyams pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi sgo ston pa dang*/ zung dang snrel zhi'i rgyud la mkhas pa dang*/ ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing 'du mi byed pas dge sdig gi blang dor la mkhas pa dang*/ bzod pa'i lus kyi sems can mi gtong ba dang*/ 'gro kun dga' bar ston pa dang*/ byis pa dang nyan thos kyi nang du thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems mi nyams pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos tshol ba las mi zlog pa rnams so/ /don 'di nyid zhib mor rtogs par 'dod na/ bden pa po'i le'u las rgyas par bshad pas der blta'o/ /byang chub spyod pa zhes pa nas/ de yan chad ni bzang po spyod pa dang*/ byang chub spyod pa sgrub pa'i dbang du byas shing*/ mos spyod kyi sa la gnas pa dang*/ thun mong ba'i yon tan gyi dbang du byas pa'i smon lam mo/ /don tshan brgyad dgu bcu pa/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang*/ skyon gsum las grol ba dang ma chags pa ni/ sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par gyur pa dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shog /las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las/ /grol zhing 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams su yang*/ ji ltar padmo chu mi chags pa bzhin/ /nyi zla nam mkhar thogs pa med ltar spyad/ /de la sdig pa ni sdig to mi dge ba'i chos te/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi nyon mongs pa dang*/ des kun nas blangs pa'i las thams cad do/ /de'i phyogs mthun pa ni/

nyon mongs pa thams cad yin te/ de bas na sdig pa gang rnams thar pa la sgrib par gyur pa dag ste/ de dag sa bon dang bcas pa ma lus pa yongs su byang bar shog cig skyon gsum ni las nyon bdud gsum mo/ /las ni khams gsum du skye bar 'gyur ba'i las dang*/ nyon mongs pa ni kun tu sbyor ba dgu'i nyon mongs pa dang*/ bdud ni chos kyi 'tsho ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon te/ 'dod pa la chags pa dang*/ rnam par g.yengs ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa dang*/ nad la sogs pa bskyed cing*/ gsod par byed pa'i las can nam/ de bzhin du lam bzang po las zlog tu bcug nas dka' thub ngan pa dang*/ lta ba ngan pa la sogs pa la yang sbyor bar byed pa ste/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po la sogs pa'o/ /gang byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi lus thob pa phan chad du/ rang nyid la ni bdud kyi las kyis 'jug pa med la/ de las gzhan la ni yod do/ /las dang nyon mongs pa'i skyon gyis 'khrid pa yang de dang 'dra la/ 'on kyang de gnyis spangs pa'i dus ni/ mthong pa'i lam ste chos nyid la bzod pa 'bring po thob pa na'o/ /ma gos pa'am ma chags pa'i yon tan ni/ rang nyid gang du gnas shing spyod pa'i 'jig rten gyi 'gro ba rnams/ gang du spyod kyang rung ste/ ji ltar padmo chu nang du gnas kyang chu mi chags pa bzhin du/ rtag tu 'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor ba'i skyon las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ skye shi la sogs pas mi gos pa dang*/ nyi zla nam mkha'i la thogs pa med par rgyu ba na/ lo thog smin pa dang*/ sman rnams bskyed pa la sogs pa/ gzhan gyi don mang po spyod kyang*/ lan la re ba med cing rloms sems dang rnam par rtogs pa med pa ltar/ byang chub sems dpa' de yang sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi la sogs pas sems can la phan pa rgya chen po rtag tu sgrub kyang*/ lan la re ba dang rloms sems med pa ste/ bdag kyang de ltar spyod par gyur cig pa'o/

/bcu gcig pa sems can bde ba la 'god pa ni/ zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par/ /ngan song sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing*/ /'gro ba thams cad la ni phan par spyad// sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi khyon dang*/ phyogs bcu rnams ji tsam yod par/ ngan song gis mtshon pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal ma lus pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed la/ 'jig rten pa'i bde ba dang*/ lha mi'i lus dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing*/ de tsam du ma zad 'gro ba de rnams thams cad la ni/ thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos kyis rtag tu phan par spyod nus par gyur cig /don tshan bcu gnyis bcu gsum pa mtha' yas pa'i rnam 'phrul dang*/ 'gro don mi zad par spyod pa ni/ byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*/ /sems can dag gi spyod dang mthun par 'jug /bzang po spyod pa dag ni rab ston cing*/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid byang chub spyod pa'i sgo nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po dag ni yongs su rdzogs par byed cing*/ sems can gzhan rnams kyi khams dang*/ mos pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ bag la nyal rnams shes pas de rnams kyi spyod pa dang mthun par/ gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba'i thabs kyis 'jug ste/ khyim pas 'dul ba la khyim pa'i gzugs dang*/ rab tu byung bas 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba'i gzugs dang*/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ lha dang*/ drang srong dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ rgyal po la sogs pa gzugs sna tshogs pa dang*/ spyod pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ bshad pa sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas sems can rnams smin par byed pa'i nus pa thob pa'o/ /gzhan don du 'khor bar skyo ba med pa'i rang bzhin can de ni 'gro ba'i don 'di ltar spyod de/ rang gi rtogs pa dang mthun pa'i bzang po spyod pa dag gi chos ni/

sems can rnams la rab tu ston cing spyod pa de la 'god par mdzad pas so/ /de ltar rang gi spyod pa rdzogs pa dang nus pa thob pa dang*/ chos ston pa ste/ rang gzhan gyi don gsum po de yang*/ dus re zhig spyod par ma zad ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa mtha' med pa'i bar du kun tu spyod par 'gyur te gyur cig pa'o/ /gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas pa'i smon lam la/ grogs phun sum tshogs pa dang lhan cig par smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar/ bshes gnyen dam pa rtag tu brten cing mnyes par byas/ thun mong gi skabs su bshad pa'i spyod pa rnams dag la gnas pas chos kyi sgo'i ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs thob par gyur/ tshogs gnyis kyi mthu las byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan rnams thob/ zhing mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi drung du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pas slar yang spyod pa shin tu smin pa'i gnas skabs na/ kun khyab tu rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum nus pa dang*/ yul dus mnyam nyid du gyur pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i gsung mtha' dag la 'jug pa dang*/ rgyal tshab kyi sa la gnas pa'i spyod pa mtha' dag ston pa'i dbang du byas te/ rim pa de dang mthun par smon lam du byas pa ni/ skabs 'di'i bsdus don no/ /sdom ni/ grogs dang bshes gnyen sgo gnyis bsgrub/ /tshogs las rgyan thob sangs rgyas mchod/ /yangs dog med dang gsung dbyangs 'grub/ /rgyal tshab mchog gi spyod pa'o/ /brgyad po de la dbang 'byor drug /chos ston dus dang mthong ba dang*/ spyod yul zhing khams mdzad pa la'o/ /rtsa ba'i don tshan brgyad du 'dod/ ces pa'o/ /de la 'di ni phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i gtam la yang dag par 'jug pa'i tshul yin te/ dang po nyid du mos pa'i dge ba phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ bsod nams khyad par can sgrub pa ni/ grogs bzang po dang spyod pa gcig tu spyod cing smon lam sgrub pa yin pas/

de'i dbang du byas nas/ bdag gis spyod dang mtshungs par gang spyod pa/ /de dag dang yang rtag tu 'grogs par shog /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang*/ /spyod pa dag dang smon lam gcig tu spyad/ bdag byang chub spyod pa dang bzang po spyod pa la sbyor ba na/ bdag gi spyod pa dang mtshungs par spyod pa'i grogs gang yin pa de dag dang yang dus rtag tu 'grogs par shog cig /'grogs nas kyang*/ lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang ste/ sgo gsum gyi spyod pa de dag gcig tu mthun par spyod pa dang*/ smon lam rnams kyang gcig tu mthun par spyad pa ste mthun par smon lam 'debs pa'o/ /de yang grogs ni zang zing gi sbyin pa gtong ba la dga' la/ bdag gis ni tshul khrims kho na bsngags te/ zang zing gi sbyin pa smod par byed pa dang*/ grogs ni bdag dben par gnas pa la dga' la/ rang nyid ni khyim gyi 'tsho chas la dga' ba mi 'dor ba dang*/ grogs de ni kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi chos la ched cher 'dzin cing mos la/ rang gis ni don dam stong pa'i gtam gyis ur gnon du byed pa la sogs pa ni gnyis kar chos spyod pa yin du chug kyang*/ spyod pa mi mthun par spyod pa yin pas de ltar mi bya bar/ grogs byang chub sems dpa' chos la spyod pa de nyid dang*/ bsam pa mthun cing sbyor ba yang mthun/ bsngags pa brjod pa yang mthun/ smon lam gdab pa yang mthun par bya'o/ /de ltar na ji tsam grogs su 'grogs pa dang phyogs gcig tu tshogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ spyir so so nas dge ba la brtson par ma zad/ phan tshun gcig gcig gi dge ba la yi rang zhing*/ phan tshun du bltas nas mthun par spyod cing*/ gzhan re re dag gi chos mthun gyi 'dun pa mi 'dra ba gsar du skyes pa rnams kyang*/ mthong zhing thos na phyin chad thams cad kyis de dang 'dra bar spyod pa'am yi rang byed na/ spyod pa gcig tu spyod pa zhes bya zhing smon lam yang spyi sgrigs shig ma gtogs gzhan 'debs su mi rung ba lta ma yin mod/

dang po nyid nas spyi mthun na ni legs/ thog ma 'dod pa so so'i smon lam tha dad pa yod du chug kyang*/ de 'dra de nam mthong zhing thos la go ba na phan tshun gcig gcig so sos de dang de la khyad du gsod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang ngan du mi zer bar smon lam mthun par 'debs pa ni smon lam gcig pa ste/ 'di ni spyir chos byed tsam dang*/ sgos su da lta'i dbang du byas na/ chos brgyud gcig pa dang gnas gzhi gcig pa dang*/ bla ma gcig pa rnams la nyams len mi dgos ka med pa zhig yin te/ tshe 'di dang skye ba gzhan gyi gnas skabs thams cad du/ rten 'brel rnam dag sgrig pa dang*/ zhing sbyong ba dang*/ 'gro ba smin pa sogs la 'di kho na gal che bar yod pas/ lag len la thebs par 'tshal lo/ /gal te dngos su spyod pa mi mthun yang*/ phan tshun gnang ba sbyin pa dang*/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa sgrub pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dang mos pa'i sems dang ma bral ba de ni/ spyod pa mthun pa nyid yin te/ blo gros mthun par gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du chos min ni bzlog dgos pa yin te/ mthun par byed pa ma yin no/ /de ltar spyod pa dang smon lam gcig tu spyad pa de ni/ tshe 'di'am skye ba gzhan du mos pa'i dge ba phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing mnyes par byed pa ni/ bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs po dag /bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston pa rnams/ /de dag dang yang rtag tu 'phrad par shog /de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung*/ /bdag la bzang po spyod pa'i chos kyi lag len rab tu ston pas/ mthar thug tu phan 'dogs par 'dod pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ 'khor ba dang theg dman las yongs su skyob cing*/ theg chen gyi bde ba ster pa'i grogs po ste/ bla ma dam pa gang dag yod pa de rnam dag dang yang*/ dus rtag tu 'phrad pa ste mjal bar shog cig /bla ma dam pa de dag bdag gis dus nam yang lan gcig gam skad cig gcig kyang thugs yid mi dbyung bar bya'o/

/zhes smon pa ste/ yid 'byung ba ni mi dgyes pa yin pas mi dbyung ba ni rtag tu bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs la 'bad pa'o/ /de lta bu'i bshes gnyen dam pa bsten pa'i tshul ni 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa las/ khye'u dpal 'byung gi rnam thar las rtogs par bya'o/ /mos pa'i dge ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa de ni/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i gtam gyi chos dang*/ de ston pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa dang 'phrad par 'gyur bas/ snga ma'i mjug thog tu 'di bstan pa yin cing*/ bla ma dam pa mnyes par byed dgos par gsungs la de mnyes pa'i thabs kyang chos spyod las gzhan du med pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnams la slob dgos par grub la/ de'i thun mong gi spyod pa rnams ni sngar bshad zin cing*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i spyod pa yang*/ spyod pa dang smon lam gcig par bshad pa nyid kyis shugs la grub pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po gcig par shes pa dang*/ 'khor 'das ro mnyam rtogs pa dang*/ sems can bdag mtshungs kyi byams pa rnams yod na/ spyod smon gcig tu spyad pa khyad par du 'phags pa 'grub pa'i phyir ro/ /bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston byed pa/ /zhes pas kyang shugs las bstan te/ don dam par na kun tu bzang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtag tu bzang ba de yin la/ de la dmigs nas spyad pa spyod pa'i phyir yang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba rnams la las dang po pa'i sa la gnas pas kyang sgrub par ston pa yin no/ /de ltar grogs bzang po dang spyod pa gcig tu spyad/ bla ma dam pa yongs su bsten te spyod pa la nan tan du gnas pa des ni rim gyis dad pa'i sa dang mos pa la spyod pa'i sa phal cher bgrod par 'gyur te/ de nas ni skabs 'dir sgo dang po chos kyi sgo'i ting 'dzin ni thob pa'i dbang du byas te/ sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po rnams/

/mngon sum rtag tu bdag gis rgyal ba blta/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams sras byang chub sems dpas bskor ba yang yin la/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi mgon por gyur pa rnams ni rgyal ba zhes bya ste/ de rnams bdag gis dus rtag tu mngon sum du blta zhing mthong bar gyur la/ lan gcig tsam ma yin par dus de nas bzung ste ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa kun tu rgyun mi 'chad par sangs rgyas de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi la/ dus yun ring mo dang dka' ba chen pos mchod par byed pa la yang*/ yid mi skyo bar rtag tu dga' ba dang spro ba chen pos mchod par gyur cig pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mngon sum du mthong zhing mchod par byed pa tsam ni/ dad pa'i sa chen po la gnas pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi thob pa yan chad du/ thams cad la yod pa yin yang*/ rtag tu mthong zhing skyo ba mi srid par bshad pa ni/ mos spyod kyi sa chen por chos kyi rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin ni thob pa yan chad kho na'o/ /de thob pa na chos kyi sgo gnyis pa gzungs khyad par can yang thob pa yin te/ de ston pa ni/ rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing*/ /byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed/ /bzang po spyod pa rnam par sbyong ba yang*/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyad par bgyi/ /ji tsam mngon du gyur pa'i rgyal ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung*/ lung gi dam pa'i chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis po thams cad mi brjed pa'i gzungs kyi sgo nas 'dzin par bgyid cing*/ sems can rnams la byang chub spyod pa'i lam kun tu ston cing snang bar byed la/ bdag nyid kyis bzang po spyod pa yang dag par blangs shing*/ cung zad dam ci rigs par grub pa de nyid/ rnam par sbyang ba ste/ 'phel ba dang dag par byed par shog cig de la sbyong ba'i don 'phel ba ni/

rtsal sbyong ba lta bu dang*/ spyod pa de'i skyon dag par byed pa ni/ rims nad sbyong ba lta bu'o/ /de ltar spyod pa spyod pa yang*/ spyod pa la zhugs pa nas brtsams nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa mtha' med pa kun tu spyad par bgyi'o zhes smon pa'o/ /skabs de dag tu tshogs gnyis mang du gsog pas tshogs gnyis kyi stobs rnyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan gyi rgyan rnams kyang thob par 'gyur bas/ de ltar ston pa ni/ srid pa thams cad du yang 'khor ba na/ /bsod nams ye shes dag ni mi zad rnyed/ /thabs dang shes rab ting 'dzin rnam thar dang*/ /yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod gyur cig srid pa ni byung ba dang 'byung ba ste/ khams gsum gyi srid pa thams cad du yang*/ las dang smon lam dang ting nge 'dzin dang*/ dbang 'byor pa'i stobs kyis 'khor zhing skye ba na/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis zad mi shes pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba rnyed pa dang*/ de las sems can sgrol ba la dgos pa bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos rdzogs pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ rten 'brel dang*/ de bzhin nyid dang*/ sems can gyi don spyod pa gsum la mkhas pa'i shes rab de gsum ka la yang mnyam gzhag lhag mthong dang*/ rjes thob spyod pas bsdus pa'i dbye ba can dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod dang dri ma med pa'i phyag rgya la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa rnams dang*/ rnam par thar pa ni rnam thar brgyad dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum la sogs pa ste/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya dang*/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa'i khyad par re re spangs pa las/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes nyams su myong ba dang*/ de las byung ba'i dga' ston rnam par 'phrul ba'i rol rtsed ston pa dang*/ gzhan yang yon tan gyi khyad par kun gyis mi zad pa'i mdzod thob par gyur cig pa'o/ /de la las kyi skye ba dngos ni/ sems dpa' so skyes rnams yin la/ der yang yon tan gyi tshogs ni rtog ge ba rnams kyis bskal pa'i bar du yang blos dpyod par mi nus pa yod cing*/

'phags mchog rnams kyis las la dbang ba'i skye ba yang*/ spyir las kyi dbang gis skye ba tsam yin la/ de dang ting nge 'dzin dang*/ dbang sgyur pa'i tshul la ni/ ye shes mtha' yas yod par smos ma dgos la/ smon lam gyi skye ba'ang sems rgyud kyis bzung ba ma yin mod/ ye shes kyi mthu las byung zhing*/ ye shes dang ldan pa'i bya ba byed pa'o/ /de rnams las dbang sgyur ba'i skye ba can gyis lus dngos ni/ khams gsum du mi 'khor yang*/ de'i sprul ba 'khor pa ltar ston pa yin la/ gzhan rnams ni khams gsum du 'byung pa shas che'o/ /tshogs gnyis ni ji skad du/ rgyal ba byams pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis tshogs/ /bsod nams ye shes mtshungs pa med/ /gcig gis 'khor bar mngon mtho byed/ /gzhan gyis nyon mongs med par 'khor/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi/ / tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi/ /gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ka'i ste/ /lnga char yang ni ye shes tshogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /thabs la mkhas pa ni/ tshogs chung ngus don chen po 'grub pa dang*/ rgyu chung ngu las 'bras bu chen po 'byung ba ste shes rab phun sum tshogs pa'i byed las so/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di'i don ni/ yangs shing rgya che la bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de ltar 'phags pa'i sa la gnas par gyur na/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus grub pa dang rgyal ba'i spyod yul mtha' dag la lta bu'i nus pa thob pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal blta zhing mchod pa yin la/ don de nyid ston pa ni/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod cing blta bar bgyi/ /rdul gcig gi steng na yang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul ji snyed pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mthong bar 'gyur la/ zhing de rnams su grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/

sangs rgyas kyi sras byang sems rnams kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la/ de dag dang mtshungs par lhan cig tu byang chub spyad pa yang spyod cing*/ sku lta ba dang gsung nyan par bgyid par smon pa'o/ /'dir 'phags pa'i sa thob ma thag pa la/ zhing gi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas cig char mthong ba rang ni min yang*/ sa gzhi khyon che chung ma nges par sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing ci rigs par mthong bar nus pa yin la/ de nas rim pas gong 'phel du gyur te/ mtha' med du 'phel ba thob par 'gyur bas/ sa dang po thob ma thag pa nas dngos su rang ma thob kyang*/ zhing gi rdul snyed lta bu'i sbyor ba la zhugs pa ni yin no/ /rgyud la skye tshul de ltar yin yang*/ smon lam 'debs pa'i tshe rgya che sa nas sbyong ba yin pas/ 'dir de nyid kho na smos so/ /de ltar stong gsum yungs 'brur 'jug pa dang*/ rdul phran gcig gis phyogs bcu khyab par nus pa sogs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul yangs dog med pa ni/ sa brgyad pa mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa na yin te/ de dag gi dbang du byas nas/ de ltar ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang*/ /skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang*/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor spyod cing rab tu 'jug /rdul gcig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang pos bkod pa de ltar/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i phyogs thams cad rnams su yang*/ skra rtse tsam gyi khyon la dus gsum gyi tshad ji snyed kyi ste/ dus gsum du byung ba'i sangs rgyas grangs su bgrangs na zad mi shes pa rgya mtsho lta bu rnams/ rang rang gi zhing khams rnams dang bcas pa/ zhing khams rnams rgya mtsho ltar mi zad pa dang*/ de dag re re yang dus bskal pa rgya mtsho ltar zad mi shes pa'i bar du/ bdag kyang zhing khams re re byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod cing*/ rab tu 'jug pa ste/ lta zhing grol bar gyur cig pa'o/

/'grel ba kha cig las/ skra tsam khyon la zhes pa la/ byis pa'i lam du zhes pa'i don du bshad nas/ ma dag pa'i zhing la 'chad pa dang*/ 'dzam bu gling kho na la 'chad pa sogs ni/ bshad pa mi bde bas ma bkod do/ /rdul phran gcig gi nang du sangs rgyas kyi zhing ston pa la/ rmi lam na khang pa dog po'i nang du/ glang po che'i khyu dang nags tshal la sogs pa bde bar spyod pa snang la/ sad pa'i dus na yang dran pa dang*/ chu snod gcig gi nang du nyi zla gza' skar yul ljongs la sogs pa/ chu la gzugs brnyan du shar ba dper mdzad de/ sems kyi snang ba tsam dang*/ rten 'brel gyi mthu las/ de ltar snang ba mi 'gal ba dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir yid ches par bya'o/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa las kyang*/ 'jig rten mgon po skyob pa yis/ /bsam gtan las dang klu rnams dang*/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid che rnams kyi/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bzhir bshad do/ /zhes gsungs te/ bsam gtan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu dang*/ las kyi mthu dang*/ klu mchog gi rdzu 'phrul dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan to/ /'di legs par mthar phyin pa ji lta ba bzhin ni/ chos kyi sprin la gnas pa yan chad kyi yon tan yin la/ rjes mthun pa'am 'go brtsams pa ni/ mi g.yo ba'i sa yan chad do/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag la 'jug pa ni/ gsung gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis/ /rgyal ba kun dbyangs yan lag rnam dag pa/ / 'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin dbyangs/ /sangs rgyas gsung la rtag tu 'jug par bgyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gis gsung gcig kho na bka' stsal na/ de yang yan lag rgya mtsho ste/ gsung gi rang bzhin cha tshang ba dang cha tshang ba kho na rigs mi 'dra ba rgya mtsho ltar mtha' yas pa'i sgra skad du 'gyur te/ don dang tshig dang*/ skad dang dbyangs mtha' yas pa nyid kyis snang bar 'gyur ro/
