/de skad du yang*/ mos pa sna tshogs can gyi ni/ 'khor mang rnams ni gnas pa la/ gsung gcig bka' ni stsal ba na/ gsung rnams du mar go 'gyur zhing*/ /nga yi ched du yin no zhes/ /skye bo kun gyis rtogs 'gyur gang*/ /'di las rmad byung che ci yod/ /'di las ches mtshar ci zhig yod/ /ces so/ /gzhan yang de nyid rgyal ba sangs rgyas kun gyi gsungs dbyangs kyi yan lag skyon thams cad dang bral zhing rnam par dag pa dang*/ ngo bo gcig tu yang gnas la/ chos gang dang gang nyan par 'dod pa dang*/ de dang des 'dul bar 'gyur ba'i 'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du dbyangs de 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas gcig gi gsung gcig la khyad chos de 'dra tshang pa bzhin du/ 'dren pa ma lus pa'i gsung mtha' dag kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi gsungs thams cad la/ bdag dus rtag tu nyan pa dang*/ mi brjed par 'dzin pa dang*/ bdag gi ngag kyang rgyal ba'i gsung de dang rjes su mthun cing 'dra bar spyod pa'i tshul gyis 'jug par bgyi'o/ /'di yang mthar phyin pa'i dus ni sngar ltar yin la/ thog mar thob pa ni legs pa'i blo gros kyi sa la ste/ der so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob par bshad pa dang gnad gcig go /'dir go sla bar brjod na/ sangs rgyas gcig la chos nyan cing don go bzhin pa na/ de dang dus mnyam kho nar sangs rgyas gzhan mang po la yang chos nyan cing tshig 'dzin pa dang*/ don sems pa la gcig gis gcig la gegs mi byed cing mnyam par thos la mnyam par 'dzin cing mnyam par sems pa la dka' ba dang 'bad stsol med pa'o/ /da ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad dag /ces pa nas/ mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i bar ni rgyal tshab kyi sa la gnas pa rnams kyi yon tan dang rjes su 'brel ba'i smon lam ste/ de la rgyal tshab kyi sa zhes pa ni/ sngags kyi theg pa la sogs pa gzhung gzhan 'ga' zhig tu/

dgu pa sogs sna tshogs la bshad pa yod kyang*/ 'dir ni rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba ste/ bcu pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de la dbang 'byor ba drug ste/ chos ston pa dang*/ dus dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ spyod yul dang*/ zhing khams dang*/ mdzad pa la dbang 'byor pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad dag /'khor lo'i tshul rnams rab tu bskor ba yi/ /de dag gi yang gsung dbyangs mi zad la/ /blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /dus gsum du byon cing gshegs par 'gyur ba'i rgyal ba thams cad dag /sems can rnams grol ba'i ched du/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshul rnams rab tu bskor ba yi/ sangs rgyas de dag gi yang gsung dbyangs chos mi zad pa ste mtha' yas pa la/ rang gi blo yi mthu thob pa'i stobs kyis bdag kyang gsung gi 'phrin las de la lhan cig tu rab tu 'jug par shog cig pa ste/ 'dir snga ma gsung gcig sogs ni chos thos pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang ngo bo phyed las 'dres par thob pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /des na sa bcu'i dbang phyug gis chos ston pa de nyid sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'ang yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal snga nas chos ston pa kun la'ang*/ byang chub sems dpa' de'i 'phrin las 'jug ste/ don gcig la blo gros dang 'dun pa gcig tu bsgril pa'i dmag la sogs pa'i bya ba bzhin no/ /'di'i rab tu 'jug pa zhes pa 'dres pa ste/ chu klung rgya mtshor 'jug pa lta bu ste gsung nyan pa kho na la sbyor na snga ma dang zlos pa'i skyon yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma 'ong bskal pa thams cad 'jug par yang*/ /skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi/ /gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dang*/ /skad cig cha shas kyis ni zhugs par spyad/ /ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa mang po thams cad du/ nam mkhas gar khyab kyi 'jig rten mtha' yas pa rnams su/

ji snyed pa'i chos 'byung ba thams cad la ye shes 'jug ste mngon shes kyis shes par gyur pa yang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis mkhyen pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang ye shes skad cig gcig gis 'jug pa ste/ shes pa gcig gis dus thams cad kyi dngos po thams cad cig car shes par bgyi zhes smon pa dang*/ gang yang bskal pa sngon 'das pa thams cad dang*/ da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa 'byung 'gyur te dus gsum ji tsam yod pa dang tshad mnyam pa'i bskal pa de dag thams cad skad cig gcig gi cha shas su 'jug cing bsgyur nus pa'i stobs kyis ni/ bskal pa gcig nas bskal pa mtha' med pa'i bar ji ltar 'os 'os su skad cig gi nang du zhugs par byas nas/ /byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod par gyur cig pa'o/ /'di ni dbang thob pa na/ bskal pa'am bskal pa mang po skad cig tu sdud pa dang*/ skad cig re re la yang bskal pa du ma ston pa ste/ dper bgyi na sems can spyi mthun gyi rtsa ba'i snang ba la/ skad cig gcig gam yud tsam gcig la sogs par snang ba'i dus tshod de la/ byang chub sems dpa' rang nyid kyi snang ba la yang bskal pa dang skad cig mi 'gal bar 'char ba dang*/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i stobs kyis zhing khams 'di'i go sa dang*/ phyogs bcu gzhan gyi zhing khams mang por/ de dang de'i sems can kun la bskal pa mang po yang dngos su myong zhing*/ dus de snyed du chos spyad pas tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa byang bar gyur pas te/ skad cig gcig la bskal pa mtha' yas pa'i bar du sgrub dgos pa'i tshogs gsog longs yang spyod/ spyod pa spyod longs yang yod cing*/ gsog pa dang spyod nus pa'o/ /yang spyi mthun snang ba rtsa ba de la bskal ba mang po yod kyang yun ring du thogs par ma nges te/ bskal pa skad cig mar sdud pa'i phyir dang*/ bskal pa mang po'i bya ba nyams su myong bas yud tsam gcig la grub par yang nus la/

bya ba yud tsam gcig pu lan gcig gis bskal pa'am bskal pa mang po 'khyongs par yang byed do/ /de ltar na dus thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis/ dus ring thung dbye ba med par spyod pa ste/ 'di'i dgos pa ni skad cig la yang mtha' yas pa'i byed long yod la/ bskal pa la yang yun ring bsgug mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ dus thung ngu la bya ba rgya chen po mi 'grub par dogs pas/ blo tsab tsob tu 'gyur ba dang*/ rgya chen po la yun ring thogs pas ngal zhing skyo bar 'gyur ba'i gnyen po'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge gang*/ /de dag skad cig gcig la bdag gis blta/ /dus gsum du byung zhing gshegs pa'i mi yi seng ge bcom ldan 'das gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig gcig la dus gcig tu/ lus pa med par bdag gis mngon sum du lta zhing*/ dus kyang thung ngu ma yin par rtag tu blta bar bgyi'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnam thar stobs kyis 'jug /rtag tu sangs rgyas de dag gi ni spyod yul te/ rtogs bya'i yul dang rtogs byed kyi ye shes dang*/ de dag gi rnam par thar ba dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug par gyur cigatshul ji lta bus 'jug na/ mnyam bzhag gi ye shes bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po spros bral rnam pa thams cad pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes mngon sum du rtogs pa'i nus pas/ rjes thob kyi ye shes sgyu ma ltar snang bar gyur la de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs las/ sgrib pa'i khyad par mang po las grol zhing rnam par thar ba'i stobs kyis gang la gang 'dod du sgyur thub cing spyod pa'i tshul gyis so/ /'di ni don la nges par na sangs rgyas dang 'phrin las mnyam por spyod pa'i don no/ /lnga pa ni/ gang yang dus gsum dag gi zhing bkod pa/

/de dag rdul gcig steng du mngon par sgrub/ /de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rgyal ba dag gi zhing rnams bkod la 'jug /gang yang dus gsum du byung zin dang 'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa de dag thams cad/ mos pa dang*/ smon lam dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis/ rdul phra rab gcig gi steng ste go sa ru/ mngon par sgrub cing*/ rdul gcig po de la sgrub pa ltar/ ma lus pa'i phyogs rnams thams cad du/ rdul mtha' dag la rgyal ba dag gi zhing rnams sgrub cing bkod pa yid du 'ong ba dang*/ rgyan gyi khyad par rnam pa thams cad pa la 'jug par gyur cig pa ste/ skabs 'di'i 'jug pa zhes pa ni/ zhing khams de lta bu ston nus pa'i bya ba la 'jug pa'o/ /rdul gcig la dus gsum gyi zhing khams mtha' dag ston pa ni gzhi phra shos dang bkod pa rgya che shos kyi ya mtha' nas bzung ba yin pas/ spyir bkod pa yang*/ rdul gnyis pa'i bkod pa nas brtsams te dus gsum gyi zhing gi bar du sna tshogs par ston to/ /des mtshon te rim pa bzhin du sbyar nas/ nyi zer rdul re re la yang dus gsum gyi zhing khams la sogs pa de ltar ston pa dang*/ bye ma'i 'bru re re 'am/ spu nyag re re'am/ 'bras la sogs pa 'bru re re'am/ rtswa re re'am shing gel ba re re'am/ lo ma re re'am/ me tog re re'am/ 'bras bu re re'am/ khyim re re'am/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ rgyang grags re re'am/ dpag tshad re re'am/ ri bo re re'am/ grong khyer re re'am/ gling re re'am/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re'am/ stong gsum re re la sogs pa'i bar du yang de ltar ston la/ so so so sor thad mnyam pa la yang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams gcig la go sa tha mi dad par/ 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa yang tshad mnyam pa du ma gcig shul du gcig ston la/ gzhi tshad chen po la chung ngus khyab pa yang dpag tu med pa ston te/

stong gsum gcig gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gis khyab pa dang*/ 'dzam bu gling gcig gis khyab pa dang*/ grong khyer gcig gis khyab pa dang*/ lus gcig gis khyab pa dang*/ skra gcig gis khyab pa dang*/ rdul phran gcig gis khyab pa'i bar du yang ston to/ /yang rdul phran gzhan gcig gi nang du chud pa de nyid kyis/ gzhan stong gsum mang po yang non pa dang*/ gzhan du dus kyang nges pa med par ston te 'das pa yang ma 'ongs ba dang ma 'ongs pa yang 'das par sgyur ba la sogs pa rnam par 'phrul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa kho na 'byung ba'o/ /drug pa ni/ gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgron me rnams/ /de dag rim par 'tshang rgya 'khor lo bskor/ /mya ngan 'das pa rab tu zhi mtha' ston/ / mgon po kun gyi drung du bdag mchi'o/ /gang yang ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten snang bar byed pa'i sgron me de dag rnams/ rang rang gi mdzad pa'i rim pa mtha' dag ston pa rnams ma 'khrugs par spyod de/ sangs rgyab dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa sdug bsngal rab tu zhi ba'i mtha' thob pa'i tshul ston par mdzad pa'i/ mgon po sangs rgyas de dag kun gyi drung du bdag dus gcig tu mchi ba ste/ 'gro zhing bslebs la phyin par bgyi'o/ / zhes smon pa ste sangs rgya ba sogs mdzad pa gsum ni mtshon pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du der phyin par byas nas/ ci zhig byed ce na mchod pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul ston pa dang chos bstan pas sems can 'dul ba dang*/ chos kyi don 'dri ba la sogs pa/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad kyi dpung rogs bya ba yin la/ don la bdag nyid gsar du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin gyi dbang du byas na ni/ mdzad pa 'phrin las gcig pa kho nar 'gyur zhing*/ sa bcu pa nyid la gnas pa'i skabs yin na yang*/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba la sangs rgyas su gyur te sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ston pa dang*/

sangs rgyas su mi ston yang*/ sangs rgyas gzhan gyis mdzad pa'i las byed pa por 'byung ba yin no/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kar la 'jug pa'i/ rnam grangs gzhan gyi smon lam bstan pa la/ sgrub pa gtso bor gyur pa stobs kyi smon lam dang*/ phan yon gtso bor gyur pa bsam mi khyab kyi smon lam dang*/ mthar thug smon lam bla na med par gcig tu bya ba ste/ gsum las/ dang po la/ stobs bcu bshad pa dang*/ de'i byed las bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang*/ /kun nas sgo yi theg pa'i stobs rnams dang*/ /kun tu yon tan spyod pa'i stobs rnams dang*/ /kun tu khyab par byams pa dag gi stobs/ /kun nas dge ba'i bsod nams stobs rnams dang*/ /chags pa med par gyur ba'i ye shes stobs/ /shes rab thabs dang ting 'dzin stobs dag gis/ /byang chub stobs rnams yang dag sgrub par byed/ / mchod pa dang*/ chos ston pa dang*/ sems can gyi don du/ mtha' med pa'i zhing khams rnams kyang skad cig gis bgrod nus shing*/ zhing tha dad par du mar yang dus gcig car bgrod thub pas kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs rnams dang*/ kun nas sgo zhes bya ba ni/ sgo kun dang ldan pa'i don te/ thabs tshul gyis rim pa mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas/ sems can gyi don spyod pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni/ de la brten nas bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bgrod nus pa'i phyir/ bzhon pa dang 'dra bas theg pa'i stobs te de rnams dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang bsdu dngos bzhi dang tshad med bzhi la sogs pa/ yon tan du ma dang 'grogs pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu dang zad par bcu dang*/ zil gnon brgyad dang*/ mngon shes drug la sogs pa yon tan kun tu spyod pa'i stobs rnams dang*/ kun nas sems can thams cad la nye ring med par khyab pa'i byams pa la sogs pa tshad med bzhi po dag gi stobs dang kun tu sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba byed pa'i phyir/

rab tu dge ba'i sbyin sogs bsod nams kyi stobs rnams dang*/ dus gsum gyi dngos po thams cad la chags thogs med par 'jug pa'i mngon par mkhyen pa/ ye shes kyi stobs dang*/ chos dbyings ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi stobs dang*/ gzhan don sgrub pa la mkhas pa thabs mkhas kyi stobs dang*/ dmigs pa la rtse gcig pa gang zhig mngon shes dang rnam 'phrul la sogs pa yon tan bskyed pa'i rgyu/ dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs te/ stobs dgu po de dag gi sgo nas 'bad pas/ byang chub kyi stobs te bla na med pa'i byang chub 'phral du thob par byed pa'i ye shes kyi khyad par/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes nyid dang rnam pa mthun cing rgya khyon mtshungs pa'i lam gyi bden pa ni/ byang chub kyi stobs yin la/ de yang rnam pa mtha' yas pa 'dzin pa'i phyir/ rnams zhes mang po'i sgra smos te/ de rnams yang dag par sgrub par byed par shog cig pa'o/ /'dir bshad pa'i stobs 'di rnams/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin dang phal po che'i skabs gzhan las 'byung ba ltar gyi byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcu dang phal cher 'dra bar snang ste/ ji ltar zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcu ni/ bsam pa lhag bsam sbyor ba dang*/ shes rab smon lam spyod pa dang*/ theg pa rnam 'phrul byang chub dang*/ chos 'khor bskor ba'i stobs rnams so/ /'dir shes rab kyi stobs dang*/ byang chub kyi stobs dang*/ spyod pa'i stobs dang*/ theg pa'i stobs ni dngos su gsal la/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i stobs ni rdzu 'phrul dang bsam pa'i stobs ni byams pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs ni ye shes dang*/ sbyor ba'i stobs ni bsod nams kyi stobs dang*/ thabs kyi stobs gcig po'i nang tshan nas gtso bo khyad par can logs su phye ba ni smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i stobs gnyis so/

/de bas na gzhung 'dir bshad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs lhag pa ltar byung yang spyod pa dang*/ lhag bsam du 'dus par mngon no/ /gnyis pa stobs kyi byed las ni/ las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag byed cing*/ /nyon mongs stobs rnams kun tu pham par byed/ /bdud kyi stobs rnams stobs med rab byed cing*/ /bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyi/ /de la spangs par bya ba'i las ni/ khams gsum po spyod par byed pa ste/ las dngos dang*/ las rjes su mthun pa'o/ /las dngos kyang mi dge ba'i las dang*/ zag bcas kyi dge ba'o/ /zag bcas kyi dge ba de yang gnyis te/ 'dod khams kyis bsdus pa'i dge ba bsod nams dang*/ khams gong ma gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i dge ba mi g.yo ba'i las so/ /rjes su mthun pa'i las ni/ las rnams kyis bzhag pa'i bag chags gang yin pa ste/ de lta bu'i las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag par byed cing*/ nyon mongs pa ni/ lus dang sems rab tu ma zhi bar rnyog pa dang rang nyid la gnod par byed pa'i rnam rtog ste/ 'dod chags dang khong khro dang*/ nga rgyal dang ma rig pa dang*/ the tshom ste lta ba min pa lnga dang*/ 'jigs tshogs la lta ba dang*/ log par lta ba dang*/ mthar lta ba dang*/ lta ba mchog 'dzin dang*/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin te lta ba lnga'o/ /de dag ni rtsa ba yin la/ gzhan yang khro ba la sogs pa nye ba'i nyon mongs pa nyi shu dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i rab dbye phra mo gzhan rnams dang*/ nyon mongs pa rnams kyi bag chags dang gnas ngan len gang yin pa rnams kyang ste/ nyon mongs pa'i stobs rnams kun tu pham pa ste/ nyon mongs phal cher spangs shing*/ 'ga' zhig rtsad nas rang ma spangs kyang*/ de la rang dbang 'byor pa'i tshul gyis/ de'i stobs bcom nas lam gyi grogs su byas pa'o/ /skabs 'dir phyogs re mgo gnon gyi gnyen po spyad pa rnam par sbyong ba dang*/ mtha' dag dpyis 'byin gyi gnyen po bdag med gnyis dang*/

nyon mongs byang chub kyi yan lag tu sgyur ba'i thabs mkhas la sogs pa'i rnam bzhag rnams gzhan las 'byung ba ltar rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /bdud kyi stobs rnams zhes pa la spyir bdud bzhi yin yang*/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud ni sngar bshad zin pas/ phung po'i bdud dang 'chi bdag gi bdud dang lha bu'i bdud do/ /gang 'dus byas thams cad la/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa dang rtag pa'i chos rdul tsam yang mi dmigs te/ phung po stong par rtogs pas phung po'i bdud bcom pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni rtag cing brtan la/ skye 'jig thams cad dang bral par rtogs pas 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom shing*/ kun rdzob tha mal gyi sdug pa dang mi sdug pa sogs yul la mngon par ma zhen la/ chos nyid kyi gzugs sogs don dam pa'i spyod yul mtha' yas pa la mngon par spyod pa'i phyir/ gang zhig nyon mongs skyed du 'jug cing*/ sdig to mi dge ba'i chos la 'khrid pa'i lha'i bu'i bdud bcom pas na/ bdud kyi stobs rnams ni stobs med cing mi mngon par rab tu byed pa dang*/ bzang po spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyid pa ste/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas thob par smon pa'o/ /gnyis pa phan yon gtso bor ston pa bsam mi khyab gyi smon lam ni/ zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*/ /sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par grol/ /chos rnams rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing*/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu rtogs par byed/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*/ /smon lam rgya mtsho rab tu rdzogs par byed/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing*/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor mi skyo spyad par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams rgya mtsho thams cad bde ba can dang*/ padma can gyi 'jig rten bzhin du ngan 'gro dang nad dang sdug bsngal dang*/ lta ba log pa dang*/ ngam grog dang*/ tsher ma la sogs pa spangs pa/

rin po che'i sa gzhi dang ljon pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa ste bzang po 'ba' zhig tu byed cing*/ sems can rgya mtsho dag ni sdug bsngal dang sgrib pa las rnam par grol bar byed pa dang*/ lung rtogs kyi chos rgya mtsho rnams ni/ shes rab kyi mig gis rab tu mthong bar byed cing*/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos mngon sum du mthong ba'i ye shes rgya mtsho rnams ni/ rab tu rtogs pa ste thob par byed la/ spyod pa ste bdag gzhan la phan pa'i thabs rgya mtsho lta bu dag la ni/ bsam pa dri ma can la sogs pa'i skyon rnams/ rnam par dag par byed cing rang gzhan gyi don gyi smon lam grangs med pa rgya mtsho rnams ni/ rab tu rdzogs pa ste 'bras bu 'grub par byed pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho thams cad ni/ mchod pa rnam pa bcu la sogs pa thams cad kyis/ rab tu mchod par byed cing*/ de ltar zhing dag par byed pa la sogs pa bdun po de yang*/ bskal pa rgya mtsho ste mtha' med pa'i bar du skyo ba med cing rab tu dga' bas spyad par bgyi zhes smon pa'o/ /de ltar na rgya mtsho lta bu brgyad kyis/ dang po gnyis ni zhing sbyong dang sems can smin byed yin la/ lhag ma lnga ni smon lam dang tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs so/ /tha ma ni rdzogs smin sbyang gsum de ji tsam du spyod pa'i dus bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa smon lam mthar thug bla na med par gcig tu bya ba ni/ gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yis/ /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam bye brag rnams/ /bzang po spyod pas byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /de kun ma lus bdag gis rdzogs par bgyi/ /gang yang dus gsum du byon gshegs mdzad pa'i/ rgyal ba mtha' yas pa rnams kyis sngon thog ma med pa'i dus nas brtsams pa'i/ byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam gyi bye brag mtha' yas pa de rnams kun/ ma lus par bdag gis rdzogs par bgyi bar smon pa'o/

/de yang dus nam gyi tshe rdzogs par 'gyur snyam na/ bzang po spyod pa spyad pas bla na med pas byang chub tu sangs rgyas par gyur nas zhes pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi smon lam bdag gis rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyal sras mchog gnyis dang yang smon lam gcig tu bya ba ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo pa/ /gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes bya/ /mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par spyad pa'i phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /de yang rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi mchog thu bo pa/ gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang po zhes bya bar grags pa'i/ mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par chos la spyod pa'i phyir/ bdag gi dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /'di la kun tu bzang po nyid kyis rang dang mtshungs par smon lam byed par mi 'thad do snyam na/ 'di ni gzhon nu nor bzang la sogs pa rjes 'jug rnams kyi 'debs pa'i don du gsungs pas mi 'gal la/ kun bzang nyid kyis rang don du ni smon lam gzhan rnams kyang 'debs mi dgos par khyad med do/ /tshul ji ltar na/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing*/ /spyod pa rnam dag zhing rnams yongs dag dang*/ /bsngo ba bzang po mkhas pa ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par shog /sems can gang la gang 'dul gyis lus mtha' yas par ston pa dang*/ dbyangs gcig 'gro ba kun gyi skad dang 'byor ba'i ngag dang*/ rnam par mi rtog bzhin du ma 'dres par shes la snying rje chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la yang 'jug nus pa'i yid kyang ste/ sgo gsum rnam par dag par gyur cing*/ phar phyin drug gi spyod pa la/ ser sna sogs kyi dri ma rnam par dag pa dang*/ zhing ma dag pa rnams kyang yongs su dag par 'gyur ba dang*/ bsngo ba bzang po mtha' dang bral ba btab pa'i mkhas pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams/ kun bzang dang lhan cig spyod pa ci 'dra ba de 'drar bdag kyang kun tu bzang po dang mtshungs par shog cig 'grel pa kha cig las/

mkhas pa bzang po bsngo ba ci 'dra ba/ /zhes 'don te/ don la khyad cher med do/ /kun nas dge ba bzang po spyod pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal gyi ni smon lam spyad par bgyi/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de yi bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /thog mtha' bar gsum kun tu kun nas dge ba'i chos/ bzang po spyod pa spyad pa'i phyir/ 'phags mchog 'jam dpal gyi smon lam ji lta ba bzhin du bdag gis kyang spyad par bgyi ste/ spyod par gyur cig sangs rgyas rnams dang kun bzang dang 'jam dpal gyi smon lam de kun/ ma 'ongs mtha' med pa'i bskal pa kun tu mi skyo zhing*/ dga' spro dang bcas par/ rgyal ba sras bcas de'i bzhed don gyi bya ba ma lus pa bdag gis rdzogs par bgyi ba smon pa'o/ /gsum pa don bsdu ni/ spyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig /yon tan rnams kyang tshad gzung med par shog /spyod pa tshad med pa la gnas nas kyang*/ /de dag 'phrul pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ /bdag gis sbyin pa la sogs pa rgyud spyod pa dag gi mtha' ni/ 'di tsam mo zhes tshad bzung du yod par ma gyur cig /de las 'byung ba'i 'bras bu gzungs dang spobs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams kyang*/ tshad bzung du med par shog cig /de ltar spyod pa dang yon tan tshad bzung med pa la gnas par byas nas kyang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag rnams kyi/ sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad bdag gis 'tshal pa ste/ thog mar mthong zhing shes la/ mthar thob par 'gyur bar smon pa'o/ /gzhung 'dir 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas la sbyor tshul/ yang nas yang du byung yang*/ 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag sgos su rgyas shing gsal bar mi 'byung ba ni/ bzang po spyod pa po 'dod chen pa ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ dang po'i sems bskyed pa dang 'brel ba'i smon lam gyi dbang du byas pa dang*/ sems dpa' chen po'i gnas skabs na/

rang don yid byed kyi khyad par gzhan ni cher mi 'byung la/ bdag don du byang chub gnyer ba tsam zhig 'byung nye na/ de spong pa'i du yang bzang po spyod pa'i dam bca' byed pa'o/ /so so skye bo'i gnas skabs thams cad du yang*/ rang don yid byed 'gog pa la/ dam bca' 'di kho na gal che zhing*/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba dang mthar thug pa yang bzang po spyod pa'i dam bca' la ltos pa yin pa dang*/ byang chub bsgrub pa la ngang thung ba spong ba'i go cha chen po yang 'di'o/ /gsum pa smon lam gyi mtha' dang phan yon bstan pa la/ smon lam gyi mtha' bshad pa dang*/ phan yon dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa zhes pa la/ nam mkha' la mtha' med phyir/ phyogs bcu mtha' med pa ji tsam par/ sems can ma lus pa'i mtha' yas de bzhin te mtha' med pa'o/ /sems can ji tsam par las dang nyon mongs pa yang de tsam ste/ ji tsam las dang nyon mongs pa'i mtha' tshad gzung du med par gyur pa de bzhin du/ bdag gi smon lam gyi mtha' yang de tsam dang mnyam pa'i phyir tshad med pa'o/ /mdor na sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs gcig kyang ma lus pa bdag gis sel ba dang*/ sems can gcig kyang ma lus par thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i smon lam dang*/ de ma rdzogs kyi bar du yang sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal dang mi 'dod pa mtha' dag bdag gis 'joms pa dang*/ gang dang gang du ji ltar 'os pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang bdag gis sgrub par smon cing*/ de ltar smon pa yang dad pa dang snying stobs shin tu brtan pa la gzhi byas/ snying rje chen po dang*/ 'dun pa dang brtson 'grus drag pos mtshams sbyar/ de thams cad stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dang ji ltar dmigs pa de ltar thams cad la dbang 'byor ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nang du bcug ste/

dus bskal pa mtha' med par sgyur byed kyi grogs tshogs bsags pa'i sgo grangs med pas yongs su sgyur te bsngos shing smon lam btabs pa yin pa'i phyir/ smon lam de yang ji ltar bsngos pa dang mthun par ni 'grub la/ 'khor ba'i gnas na sems can gcig kyang ma lus par rdzogs pa ni mi srid pa'i phyir/ smon lam 'di yi 'bras bu rdzogs zin nas zad pa ni mi srid pa/ des na sems can mtha' yas pa zhig rgyun mi 'chad par grol bar 'gyur yang*/ sems can gyi khams la 'phel 'grib med de mi zad pa bzhin du/ smon lam 'di yang ji ltar smon pa dang mthun pa'i gzhan don rlabs chen rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'bras bu 'byin bzhin du phyi ma'i mu mthar thug par spyad du zin kyang*/ de'i 'bras bu zad cing rdzogs pa ni mi srid do/ /des na smon lam rdzogs pa ni 'grub rung thams cad 'grub nus pa'i don yin/ sngar rdzogs zin pa'i don min no/ /tshigs bcad 'di yang smon lam gyi ngo bo shin tu bzang zhing rgya che bar ston pa yin pas dang*/ grub 'bras kyi che ba ston pa yin pa'i phyir/ phan yon gyi don tshan du 'dus so snyam pa ni bdag gi rnam par rtog pa'o/ kha cig smon lam ji tsam du 'debs pa'i tshad bstan pa zer te mi legs so/ /gnyis pa phan yon dngos bstan pa la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa/ /rin chen brgyan te rgyal ba rnams la phul/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba'i mchog rnams kyang*/ /zhing gi rdul snyed bskal par phul ba bas/ /gang gis bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di thos nas/ /byang chub mchog gi rjes su rab mos shing*/ /lan cig tsam yang dad pa bskyed pa ni/ /bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /'dis ni bsod nams khyad par du 'phags pa yongs su sdud pa bstan te/ mchod pa'i yul zhing gi mchog sangs rgyas la/

mchod pa'i dngos po rgya che ba sna tshogs phan byed mang*/ zhes pa ltar/ khyad par bzhi ldan phul ba de 'jig rten du bsod nams ches che bar grags na/ de bas bsngo ba 'di la mos pa bskyed pa yang phan yon che ste/ 'di la 'di dang phyi ma'i phan yon gzhan mtha' yas yod pa ni smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes pa'i don te/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhing khams mtha' yas pa rab tu rgya che ba rnams/ mchod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ ind+ra nī la'i ri bo la sogs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing bkang nas/ de las gzhan phan par byed pa'i dngos po/ lha dang mi'i bde ba'i rgyu mchog ste/ kha zas dang gos dang gnas khang dang bang mdzod dang*/ bzhon pa dang*/ 'bru dang*/ gzhan yang 'dod pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa dang bcas pa'i phyogs bcu'i zhing khams de dag rnams kyang*/ grangs ches mang ba zhing gi rdul snyed dang*/ dus mang ba bskal pa'i bar du rgyun mi 'chad par/ zhing gi dam pa rgyal ba rnams la phul na bsod nams shin tu che'o zhes grags so/ /de ni gong du smos pa ltar/ gzhi dang mtshams sbyor dang*/ 'dzin byed dang*/ sgyur ba khyad par can bzhi po des ma zin cing*/ byang chub tu ma bsngos na nan tar na de tsam du ches che ba ma yin te/ bsod nams de yang zag pa dang bcas pa dang*/ rnam smin myong nas zad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bas ni 'di bzang ste gang gis bzang po spyod pa bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di/ thos shing thos byung gi shes rab kyis go nas bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog gi rjes su rab tu mos pa ste/ byang chub la mtha' yas pa'i yon tan dang ldan par nges shes skyes shing*/ des drangs te snying thag pa nas byang chub la dang ba'i dad pa lan cig tsam yang skyed cing smon lam 'debs pa de ni/ snga ma de bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'gyur te/

dad pa po'i dad pas smon lam 'debs pa po 'di ni de 'drar 'gyur ba'o/ /yang na 'dir dad pa bskyed pa kho na'i phan yon la sbyar kyang chog ste/ gzhung gi dngos bstan de tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de las de mchog yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni phyi ma 'di ni zag pa med pa'i dge ba yin pa dang*/ 'di las nges par sangs rgyas kyi sa bon thebs nas/ phugs kyi 'bras bu mi zad pa'i phyir ro/ /rjes su mos pa'i don ni/ byang chub nyid kyi gnas tshul dang mthun par/ mos pa byas pa'i don yin te/ mos pa gang dag mos yul dngos po'i rjes su mi 'gro ba/ lha nag po dang drag po dbang phyug la sogs pa nyon mongs kun tu spyod pa la nyon mongs med par 'dod pa sogs mos pa dngos po dang rjes su mi mthun pa de rnams dgag pa'i don no/ /thos nas zhes pas/ don ma go ba dang*/ mos pa dang dad pa zhes bstan pas gzhan gyis bskul ba dang 'gran pa'i phyir dang*/ g.yom rgyugs su smon lam 'debs pa sogs/ 'di dag la dngos su phan yon chen po de lta bu mi 'byung ngo*/ /zhes pa'i don te/ 'on kyang bsam pa dag pa dang ma dag pa gang yin yang rung ste/ chos 'di dang 'brel pa thob pa'i phyir ma 'ongs pa na don chen po dang 'phrad pa'i rgyu ni nges par yin no/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad ni/ gang gis bzang spyod smon lam 'di btab pa/ /des ni ngan song thams cad spang bar 'gyur/ /des ni grogs po ngan pa spangs pa yin/ /snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthong*/ /de dag rnyed pa rab rnyed bde bar 'tsho/ /mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ong*/ /kun tu bzang po de yang ci 'dra bar/ /de dag ring por mi thog de bzhin 'gyur/ / mtshams med lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams/ /gang gis mi shes dbang gis byas pa dag /de yis bzang po spyod pa 'di brjod na/ /myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ /ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang*/

/rigs dang kha dog rnams dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang pos de mi thub/ / 'jig rten gsum po kun na'ang mchod par 'gyur/ /byang chub shing dbang drung du de myur 'gro/ /song nas sems can phan phyir der 'dug ste/ /byang chub 'tshang rgya 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa thams cad btul/ /skyes bu gang gi dad pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas/ phan yon rnam pa bcu gsum po 'di dag rim gyis thob par 'gyur te/ phan yon dang po ni/ skyes bu gang zhig gis smon lam 'di brtson pas btab par byas na/ ngan song du skye 'gyur gyi sdig pa thams cad byang nas/ des ni re zhig las kyi dbang gis ngan song du 'gro ba thams cad spangs par 'gyur ba'o/ /phan yon gnyis pa ni/ smon lam 'di 'debs pa des ni/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du grogs po ngan pa spangs pa yin te/ grogs ngan pa dang 'phrad par mi 'gyur zhing*/ sngar 'phrad pa'i rgyun dang 'bral ba yin no/ /de la grogs po ngan pa ni sdig pa'i grogs po nyon mongs pa 'phel bar byed cing*/ las ngan sdig pa la sbyor bar byed pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang thos bsam sgom gsum 'phel ba la bar du gcod pa'i byed pa ste/ tshe 'di'i 'dod yon dang*/ dgra gnyen la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i bya ba la sbyor ba'am/ thar pa'i lam du rlom yang rung ste/ lta ba dang spyod pa log pa la sbyor ba de dag ni bla ma'am rje dpon nam/ grogs thad kar mnyam pa'am/ g.yog gam slob mar gyur pa yin yang rung ste/ mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam sdig pa'i grogs po dang*/ bdud kyi dpung gnyen zhes bya ste/ me 'bar ba'am/ sprul gdug reg pa dug can ltar ring du spong dgos rgyu'o/ /de 'dra ba'i sdig grogs rang min yang*/ theg chen du zhugs pa dag theg dman du sbyor ba dang*/ zab pa dang rgya che la mos pa drang don gyi chos la sbyor ba sogs kyang grogs ngan no/

/phan yon gsum pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthong*/ / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas te 'od dpag tu med pa zhing khams bde ba can dang bcas pa yang*/ gson pa'i tshe la'ang myur du mthong ba dang*/ sangs rgyas de las chos thos pa dang*/ shi nas kyang zhing khams der skye ba'o/ /phan yon bzhi pa ni/ smon lam 'di la brtson pa de dag don chen po 'grub pa'i phyir rnyed pa rab tu rnyed pa'am/ 'bad rtsol med par chos dang ldan pa'i zas gos bsod snyoms la sogs pa rab tu rnyed pa ste 'phongs pa med pa'o/ /phan yon lnga pa ni/ bde bar 'tsho ba ste bde ba'i don ni legs pa yin la/ des na tshe gang du legs par spyod pa/ dge ba dang ma bral bas 'tsho ba'am/ dgra dang gdon dang nad la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe med pas bde bar 'tsho ba'o/ /phan yon drug pa ni/ mi tshe 'dir yang smon lam 'debs pa de dgamir skyes pa don yod par 'gyur bas legs par 'ongs ba ste/ mi tshe don ldan du byung zhes pa'i don no/ /de yang 'dir dge ba 'phel bar gyur pas/ skye ba shin tu mang por bde ba'i rgyu grub zin pa'i don no/ /yang na smon lam 'di 'debs pa de dag mi tshe 'dir yang tshe ring ba dang*/ longs spyod che ba dang*/ 'khor dang nye du sogs rtsa 'jings rgyas pa dang*/ lo legs pa dang*/ gzhan rnams byams pa dang*/ snyan par grags pa sogs legs tshogs thams cad dang ldan par 'ongs te/ 'ongs zhes pa 'byung 'gyur la byung ba'i sgras bstan pa'o/ /phan yon bdun pa ni/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa thob pa ste/ phan yon drug po de tsam du ma zad 'phags pa kun tu bzang po yon tan dang rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' yas pa/ mchod pa dang smon lam rgya mtsho la dbang 'byor pa de ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar yang*/ dus ring por mi thogs par smon lam 'debs pa de dag kun bzang nyid kyis ji ltar yon tan brnyes pa'i go rim dang mthun pa de bzhin du 'gyur ro/

/de la kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa cung zad grub pa ni/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba nas yin la/ phal cher grub pa ni sa brgyad pa nas dang*/ legs par grub pa ni sa bcu pa'o/ /phan yon brgyad pa ni/ las sgrib byang ba ste/ mtshams med pa lnga po dag gi las kyi sgrib pa rnams las/ gang yang rung ba zhig skyes bu gang gi sdig pa'i nyes dmigs mi shes pa'i dbang gis snga rol tu byas pa dag phyis de yis dad pa bskyed nas bzang po spyod pa 'di snying thag pa nas brjod na/ de yi mtshams med kyi sdig pa de dag ma lus pa myur du yongs su byang bar 'gyur ba'o/ /mi dge ba'i las thams cad dug gsum gang rung gis 'phen zhing sbyor ba yin la/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gis 'phen zhing sbyor ba rnams la'ang*/ gti mug gis 'phen pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas sdig pa thams cad mi shes pa'i dbang gis byas pa'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed cing dad pas smon lam 'di yang yang btab pas/ mtshams med byas pa'ang tshe 'di la byang bar nus na/ sdig pa phra mo rnams lta smos kyang cig dgos so/ /phan yon dgu pa ni/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa thob pa ste/ gong du bstan pa ltar khyad par bzhi ldan gyi bsngo ba 'dis yongs su bsngo ba ni/ 'phags pa'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa thob pa'i rgyu drug po yin la/ dang ni zhes pa gzugs sogs dang so sor 'byed pa'i tshig go /phan yon bcu pa ni/ lus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus kyi gzugs dang*/ de'i yon tan mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cu ste mtshan gyi yon tan brgya dang bcu gnyis la sogs pa rnams dang*/ 'gro ba drug tu skyes pa'i tshe yang*/ bram ze chen po dang*/ rgyal rigs mchog la sogs pa/ rigs phun sum tshogs pa/ kha dog gi yon tan rnams dang ldan pa'i gzugs mdzes par 'gyur ba'o/ /yang na kha dog ni/ rgya skad du warṇa te rus la 'jug pas/

gau ta ma dang*/ 'od srung la sogs pa bram ze dang*/ zla ba'i rigs dang*/ nyi ma'i rigs la sogs pa rgyal rigs kyi rus te/ rus che zhing khungs btsun pa rnams so/ /phan yon bcu gcig pa ni thub par dka' ba ste/ bdud dang bdud kyi rigs kyi lha dang 'byung po rnams kyis glags lta bar mi nus shing*/ gang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di las phyi rol tu gyur pa/ lta ba ngan pa'i 'thibs po can de dag ni mu stegs byed de/ de dag gi shes rab dang stobs kyis 'di thub par mi 'gyur la/ gzhan du na bdud dang mu stegs de dag rnams phar zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /gzhung phal cher du/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang pos de mi thub/ /ces 'byung ba dang*/ 'grel pa rngog lo chen pos bsgyur ba ltar na/ bdud dang mu stegs tshogs kyis de mi thub/ /ces 'gyur ba don la 'dra bas ji ltar bde bar sbyar ro/ /phan yon bcu gnyis pa ni/ mchod 'os su 'gyur ba'i yon tan te/ sa 'og dang sa steng dang nam mkha' la spyod pa'am 'jig rten gsum po kun na yang lha dang mi dang 'byung po rnams kyis smon lam 'di 'debs pa po de la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas mchod pa byed cing*/ gus pa dang phan 'dogs par 'gyur ro/ /phan yon bcu gsum pa ni/ mthar thug gi phan yon no/ /smon lam 'di 'debs par byed cing btab pa mthar phyin pa'i phan yon ni/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ba ste/ de ni byang chub kyi shing gi dbang po'i drung du myur du 'gro zhing*/ song nas sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir shing drung der 'dug ste/ bdud kyi rgyal po rnams rang rang gi 'khor gyi sde dang bcas pa thams cad btul nas/ byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa dang*/ bdud 'dul ba dang*/

sangs rgyas pa dang*/ chos 'khor bskor ba ste/ mdzad pa bzhi po dngos su bstan pas/ mdzad pa mtha' yas pa thams cad kyang shugs la go ba'i phyir ro/ /'dir 'gro ba rnams kyi go rim 'di ltar du mdzad pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi rim pa dang mthun zhing*/ gzhung gi dkyus ltar na bdud btul ba'i mdzad pa ni/ byang chub snying por bdud btul ba gcig pur ma zad/ snga phyi thams cad du bdud kyi las yang dang yang du 'joms par mdzad pa nyid yin te/ mdo sde nyi ma'i snying po dang*/ 'dus pa rin po che tog la sogs pa las 'byung ba lta bu ste/ snga phyi thams cad du sbyor dgos pa'i phyir/ mjug tu smos pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu'i lo tsā ba ye shes sdes kyang de bzhin du bshad do/ /byang chub kyi snying por gshegs pa la sogs pa 'di rnams/ gtso bor gzugs kyi sku mchog gi sprul sku'i mdzad pa yin mod kyi/ des de ltar ston pa la rgyu ni 'og min gyi gnas su longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rnam 'phrul la yang de bzhin du 'char ba yin no/ /longs sku rtag tu bzhugs pa dang*/ 'og min gyi gnas su bdud kyi 'jug pa med pas/ yab yum gyi skye ba ston pa dang bdud 'dul ba sogs longs sku'i mdzad pa la mi 'grig go snyam pa ni shin tu blo chung du gnas 'di dag la mun par gyur pa'i gtam yin te/ longs sku de'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig la yang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag ston pa yin pa'i phyir/ de tsam gyis longs sku mya ngan las 'das par mi 'gyur zhing*/ de na bdud yod par thal ba yang ma yin no/ /de ltar na phan yon dang po gnyis dang*/ brgyad pa las sgrib byang ba ste/ gsum po de ni mi mthun phyogs spangs pa dang*/ bzhi pa rnyed pa dang*/ lnga pa 'tsho ba dang*/ drug pa legs par thob pa ste gsum po de ni/ mthun rkyen 'byor ba'i phan yon te/

de ltar drug ni/ las dang po pa nyid nas 'phral du 'byung ba rnams so/ /gzugs phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ mchod 'os su gyur pa ni/ gtso bor smon lam la brtson pa nas bzung ba'i skye ba gnyis pa phan chad du'o/ /thub par dka' ba yang*/ 'di dang phyi ma gnyis kar na ste/ de'i phyogs gcig phar zil gyis mnan pa ni/ phyi ma phan chad do/ /bdun pa kun bzang gi spyod pa la 'jug pa dang*/ bcu pa gzugs phun sum tshogs pa'i phyogs gcig yid kyi lus ni/ sa thob pa'i dus kyi phan yon no/ /bcu gsum pa ni sangs rgyas thob pa'i dus kyi ste/ phan yon bcu gsum po yang mthong ba'i chos la 'byung ba'i phan yon dang*/ tshe phyi ma so so skye bo'i gnas skabs kyi dang*/ 'phags pa'i sa thob pa'i dang*/ mthar thug gi gnas skabs kyi phan yon te sde tshan bzhir 'dus pa yin no/ /gsum pa don bsdu ni/ gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam 'di/ /'chang pa dang ni ston tam klog pa yi/ /de yi rnam par smin pa sangs rgyas mkhyen/ /byang chub mchog la som nyi ma byed cig /skyes bu gang yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po 'di'i/ don dang tshig dang glegs bam gus pas 'chang ba dang kha ton du 'don pa dang*/ glegs bam klog par byed na yang rung ste/ de yi rnam par smin pa ste 'bras bu ni/ mtha' yas shing bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ ji lta ba bzhin du ni sangs rgyas kho nas mkhyen gyi/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi yang spyod yul ma yin na/ so so skye bo rnams kyi lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa/ byang chub kyi mchog bla na med par thob par 'gyur ba la/ som nyi ma byed cig ste the tshom med pa'o/ /'dir shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa las ni rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu mngon par mtho ba'i phun sum tshogs pa mtha' dag ni/ nyan rang sogs kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu byang chub mchog ces 'chad do/

/rtsa ba'i bzhi pa phan yon can gyi smon lam nyid bsngo ba la/ sras byang sems kyis bsngos pa la 'jug pa/ rgyal bas bsngos pa la 'jug pa/ smon lam gyi 'bras bu mngon gyur du bsngo ba/ dngos su lung bstan thob par bsngo ba/ sems can la phan pa sgrub par bsngo ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ 'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba ltar/ /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /'di la dpe phal cher nas/ 'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba ltar zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ ji ltar 'jam dpal shes bya thams cad mkhyen cing 'gro ba'i don la dpa' ba ltar/ de ltar kun tu bzang po yang ngo zhes par 'gyur la/ 'gyur 'di ltar la dpa' ba dang zer pa yig nor tsam mo/ /rgya 'grel rnams dang mkhan po ye shes sde'i 'grel pa las/ 'jam dpal dba' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*/ zhes 'don pa ltar na/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal bdud kyi sde 'joms pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i don spyod pa dang*/ shes rab mchog gis dngos por 'dzin pa 'joms pa la/ dpa' bor gyur pa des/ ji ltar bsngo ba thugs su chud cing mkhyen pa dang*/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin du dpa' bo chen po yin la/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsngo ba thugs su chud pa yang de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i mchog de dag kun gyi rjes su ste/ de dang 'dra bar bdag kyang slob par 'dod cing 'dun pa'i bsam pas/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam btab pa'i dge ba ji snyed mchis pa 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*/ /bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /dus gsum du sems can gyi don la byon cing gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis mchog tu bsngags shing bstod pa'i bsngo ba'i rgyal po bzang zhing rgya che ba'i bsngo ba mtha' yas pa gang dang gang la/

mchog tu bsngags par mdzad pa'i bsngo ba de rnams kyis/ bdag gis smon lam 'di btab pa la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa thob pa'i phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi'o ste/ de'i don ni bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi smon lam dang gcig tu 'dres te/ dge rtsa 'dis smon lam de rnams 'grub par gyur cig /de rnams kyis kyang 'di 'grub par gyur cig ces dang*/ smon lam de rnams kyi grub 'bras kyang kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'o/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos zhes sogs tshigs bcad 'di gnyis ni/ bsngo ba ma lus pa thams cad 'dus pa'i phyir/ bla na med pa'i bsngo ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de mthong nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /der song nas ni smon lam 'di dag kyang*/ /thams cad ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar shog /de ltar ma lus bdag gis yongs su bskang*/ /'jig rten ji srid sems can phan par bgyi/ /bdag ni nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed par gyur pa na/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dag ni phyir bsal zhing med par byas pa ste/ sgrib pa spyi dang khyad par du 'gyod pa la sogs pa'i sgrib pa lnga po dang*/ sangs rgyas mngon sum du mthong ba la bar du gcod pa'i sgrib pa rnams byang ba'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas de mngon du mthong bar 'gyur la/ de mthong bas kyang slar yang sgrib pa mang po zhig ni dag /ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma thob nas/ gnar gcod la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal med cing*/ 'chi ba'i sems de yang rab tu rnam par dkar ba'i ting nge 'dzin du ma dang bcas par 'gyur zhing*/ de song ma thag tu gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i rgyal po'i lus dang mtshungs pa'i bar do'i lus grub nas/

skad cig thang cig yud tsam de la bde ba can gyi zhing khams der rab tu 'gro zhing*/ der song nas ni rin po che'i padma'i ze'u 'bru'i khang par brdzus te skye ba blang nas/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam btab pa 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu de dag kyang thams cad ma lus pa mngon du 'gyur zhing 'grub par shog la/ de ltar bdag gi smon lam gyi 'bras bu de dag ma lus pa rang rgyud la dgos pa rnams kyang yongs su bskang zhing rdzogs la/ sems can gzhan rnams kyi don du dgos pa kun kyang*/ yongs su rdzogs shing re ba bskong bar byas nas/ 'jig rten ji srid ma stongs pa de srid du/ sems can rnams la phan pa mtha' yas pa rtag tu bgyid par gyur cigabazhi pa ni/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba red/ /padmo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i zhing khams phun sum tshogs pa der spyod pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor bde zhing skyid pas bzang zhing dga' ba'am/ yang na gzugs bzang zhing yid yon tan gyis dga' bar gyur pa zhes 'chad pa ltar ram/ yon tan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan cing*/ gnas ngan len gyi spyod pa spangs pas bzang ba/ nang du ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' ba dang*/ phyi rol tu smon lam gyi stobs las grub pa'i gnas dang yo byad dang 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis dga' bar gyur pa rnams kyi dbus der/ padmo dam pa rin po che'i padmo shin tu mdzes pa las/ brdzus te skyes nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe rgyal ba snang ba mtha' yas kyis mngon sum du khyod 'jig rten khams 'di zhes bya bar bskal pa 'di zhes bya ba la/ sangs rgyas 'di lta bur 'gyur ro zhes lung ston pa yang bdag gis dus de skabs su dang gnas dang grogs kyi khyad par 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor der thob par shog cig pa'o/

/lnga pa ni/ der ni bdag gis lung bstan rab thob nas/ /sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang*/ /sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyid/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der ni smon lam 'debs pa po bdag gis/ lung bstan de lta bur rab tu thob nas/ sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag rgya la sogs pa mtha' las 'das pa yis/ gzhan don la gcig tu gzhol ba'i blo'i stobs kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa rnams su yang*/ skad cig re re yang sems can mtha' yas pa rnams la/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyob pa nas brtsams te/ mtho ris dang*/ nyan rang dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i bar gyi/ phan pa mang po ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du bgyid par ste sgrub par shog ces pa'o/ /shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa'i lugs ltar na/ sprul pa bye ba brgya phrag du ma yis/ /zhes 'don zhing*/ der song nas ni zhes pa'i sho lo ka gcig po de/ phan pa mang po bgyid ces pa'i rjes 'dir 'don pa snang ngo*/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bton pa yi/ sogs sho lo ka gnyis ni sdong po bkod pa'i mdo dngos bod du yod pa 'di las mi 'byung zhing*/ rgya 'grel rnam dag gzhan rnams na yang bshad pa med do/ /shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel bar ni 'byung zhing*/ bzang spyod kyi glegs bam logs su byas pa'i rgya dpe gcig na yang snang ngo*/ /mkhan po ye shes sdes kyang bshad pa mdzad pas/ spyir mdo sde'i tshig ni yin par bya dgos so/ /des na 'dir sngar gyi sa bcad lnga po la mi the yang*/ gzhan don kho nar yongs su bsngo ba zhes bya ste/ tshigs bcad dang po ni/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bton pa yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /des ni 'gro ba'i smon lam dge ba rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'byor bar shog /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi glegs bam bklags pa dang kha ton du byas pa ni bton pa'o/

/de las bdag gis dge ba cung zad ci bsags pa des ni 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyis yid la smon zhing*/ ngag gi gyur cig par brjod pa'i smon lam gyi rigs las dge bar gtogs pa rnams thams cad 'bad stsol med cing*/ yun ring du thogs pa ma yin par/ skad cig gcig gis te myur du thams cad 'byor zhing 'grub par shog cig pa'o/ /'dis ni bdag nyid kyi bzang spyod bton pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad kyi bzang smon 'grub par smon pa yin pas/ gzhan don kho nar bsngo ba'o/ /tshigs bcad gnyis pa ni/ gang yang bzang po spyod pa 'di bsngos pas/ /bsod nams mtha' yas dam pa gang thob des/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal chu bor bying ba rnams/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab thob par shog /ces pa'am dpe 'ga' las/ bzang spyod yongs su bsngos pa'i bsod nams ni/ mtha' yas shin tu khyad 'phags gang thob des/ /zhes kyang ngo*/ /bzang po spyod pa'i bsngo ba byas pa 'di yis/ gang yang bdag gi rgyud la bsod nams te dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya che bas mtha' yas shing*/ ngo bo bzang pas dam par gyur pa gang zhig thob pa des/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi chu bor bying ba rnams/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med pa'i gnas bde ba can gyi zhing khams sdug bsngal gyi ming yang mi grag cing*/ rtag tu bde ba'i gnas de rab tu thob par shog cig pa ste/ der skye bar gyur cig pa'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i gzhung 'di la sngon bstan pa snga 'gyur gyi dus su/ lo paṇa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams kyis bsgyur ba la/ slob dpon chen po dpal phyogs kyi glang po dang*/ shākya bshes gnyen dang*/ sangs rgyas grags pa dang*/ rgyan bzang po ste/ bzhi po des mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dag 'gyur la/ de rnams kyis don legs bsdus kyi steng du/ mkhas pa'i gsung dang mdo don 'ga' zhig gis brgyan pa/

mkhan po ye shes sdes rjed byang gi 'grel chen mdzad do/ /slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa dang*/ rngog 'gyur klu sgrub kyis mdzad zer ba'i 'grel ba de gnyis rgyan bzang po'i 'grel pa dang*/ 'gyur khyad ma gtogs gcig pas/ dpe thog ma dbang btsan par byas te rgyan bzang po'i yin gyi/ slob dpon chen po de gnyis kyi ma yin no/ /rgyan bzang po'i 'grel pa 'di yang phyogs glang gi 'grel pa'i bsdus don bor zhing*/ mgo zhabs su tshigs bcad bsnan pa tsam ma gtogs lhag ma rnams bris bshus lta bu snang ngo*/ /sangs rgyas grags pa'i 'grel pa ni ma mthong la 'dir phyogs glang dang shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa'i don gyi snying po gal che ba rnams tshang bar byas la/ phal cher ye shes sde'i gsung gi yang rjes su 'brangs shing*/ rang blos rtogs pa'i legs bshad cung zad kyis kyang brgyan te bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar na sdong po bkod pa nyid las 'byung ba dang*/ rgya 'grel phal cher ltar na/ sho lo ka drug cu yin la/ shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel pa ltar na phyi ma gnyis po bsnan pa'o/ /'di nyid kyi sgos kyi glegs bam bod ma phal cher gyi mjug tu/ smon lam rgyal po 'di dag mchog gi gtso/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la phan byed cing*/ /kun tu bzang pos brgyan pa'i zhing grub ste/ /ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stongs par shog /ces 'byung ba ni/ mdo dang*/ sngar smos pa bdag gis mthong ba'i 'grel pa rnams na mi snang zhing*/ sangs rgyas grags pa'i 'grel pa na'ang med par grags la/ pa gor bai ro tsa na rakṣi ta la sogs pa 'di'i gzhung 'grel rnams 'gyur mdzad pa'i lo tsā ba dag gis/ 'gyur gyi smon lam gyi tshul du mdzad pa yin no zhes grags te/ de ltar yin pa yang sems la/ don ni bzang po zhig ste/ smon lam gyi rgyal po 'di dag ni/ mchog gi gtso bo sangs rgyas su 'grub cing*/

mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba kun la phan par byed pa dang*/ khyad par du phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus pa'i ngan song gi gnas thams cad ma lus par stongs pa dang*/ phyogs thams cad kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyis brgyan pa'i zhing khams khyad par can du bsgrubs pas grub par gyur cig pa'o/ /der ltar na tshigs bcad tha ma de gsum ni/ sdong po bkod pa nyid las mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ ma bton yang chad pa'i nyes pa med par shes par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ zab cing rgya che'i smon lam dam pa 'di/ /bdag lta rmongs pa'i spyod yul ma yin mod/ /rang gi blo gros rnam par sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dam pa'i gsung gi rjes zhugs skyon med snyam/ /stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i rang snang las/ /ting 'dzin spyod yul dam pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ /yid kyi lus dang bsam mi khyab pa yi/ /skye dang 'chi 'pho rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa/ /de ni rgyal dang sems dpa' che rnams kyi/ /spyod yul nyid yin gzhan gyi ma lags mod/ /smon lam 'dis ni de don rdzogs par ston/ /de phyir 'phags pa'i spyod yul nyag gcig go /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa gang yin pa de yang*/ skyes bu chen po'i rnam par rtog pa brgyad du 'dus pa yin no/ /rnam pa brgyad po de la ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyin dang mtshan du mngon par phyogs par byed do/ /de la sdom ni/ sdug bsngal sel dang 'byor pa dang*/ /bdag lus don dang ngan 'gror 'jug /re ba rdzogs dang 'khor las 'dren/ /'gro la phan med 'dod bral dang*/ /brgyad pa bdag gzhan brje ba yin/ /rnam rtog dang po ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal nam zhig sel bar 'gyur snyam pa dang*/ rnam rtog gnyis pa ni/ sems can dbul po rnams 'byor pa chen po la bdag gis nam sbyor bar 'gyur snyam pa dang*/

rnam rtog gsum pa ni/ sha khrag dang bcas pa'i lus 'dis sems can gyi don nam byed snyam pa dang*/ rnam rtog bzhi pa ni/ bdag ngan 'gror song nas kyang*/ sems can rnams la nam zhig phan 'dogs par 'gyur snyam pa dang*/ rnam rtog lnga pa ni/ bdag gis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'byor ba ste/ rdzu 'phrul dang longs spyod dang yon tan dang yon tan rnams kyis sems can kyi re ba rdzogs par nam 'gyur snyam pa dang*/ rnam rtog drug pa ni/ bdag sangs rgyas su gyur nas sems can 'khor ba las nam zhig 'dren par 'gyur snyam pa dang*/ rnam rtog bdun pa ni/ sems can la phan pa rgya chen po mi 'byung na skye ba dang spyod pa dang longs spyod ches phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin yang rung nam yang mi 'dod cing skra rtse bskyod pa tsam dang dbugs 'byung rngubs tshun chad kyang*/ sems can la phan pa kho na byed nus par nam zhig 'gyur snyam pa dang*/ brgyad pa ni sems can gyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal bdag la smin par gyur cig bdag gis bde ba dang dge ba sems can la 'byung bar gyur cig ces smon pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams smon lam 'debs pa'i rtsa ba bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa ni de dag yin te/ de la smon lam dngos ni/ ngag tu brjod pa la mi bya ste yid kyis so/ /de ltar yang brtan pa rnams kyi smon lam ni/ sems pa 'dun dang bcas pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pas/ skabs 'dir yang smon par bya ba'i gnas brgyad po de dag la/ rtag tu sems par byed cing*/ thob par 'dun pa ni smon lam dngos so/ /de dag kyang*/ gzhung 'dis gsal bar bstan pa yin te/ skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog dang po sems can rnams sdug bsngal med cing bde bar 'dod pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'byor pa thob par 'dod pa ni/ zhing sbyong ba dang mchod pa'i tshig rnams dang*/

de'i bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa rang lus kyi sems can la phan 'dogs pa ni/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing*/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ sgo gsum gzhan don du spyod na rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ngan 'gror zhugs nas kyang gzhan gyi don byed pa ni/ sems can dag gi spyod dang mthun par 'jug/ces pa'o/ /lnga pa sems can gyi re ba skong ba ni/ 'gro ba kun gyi chos kyis don rnams ni/ /zhes pa nas/ thams cad skad du bdag gi chos ston to/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /drug pa sangs rgyas thob nas 'gro ba sgrol ba ni/ byang chub shing dbang drung du de myur 'gro/ /sogs dang*/ sprul pa mang po bye ba phrag brgya yis/ sogs so/ /bdun pa don dam du mi 'gyur ba ni/ gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yi/ /sogs dang*/ gzhan yang shugs bstan la mang ngo*/ /brgyad pa bdag gzhan brje ba ni/ zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam par/ /ngan song sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing*/ /sems can thams cad la yang phan par bgyid/ /zhes pas bstan to/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams kyi smon lam grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu ni/ smon lam chen po bcur 'dus pa yin la/ de dag kyang 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ sa dang po'i don bsdu tshigs bcad kyi skabs su 'di skad ces 'byung ste/ rgyal ba lta ba'i don du smon lam mngon par sgrub/ /dam chos yongs su bzung zhing drang srong drung 'gro dang*/ /spyod pa mchog gi don du smon lam mngon par sgrub/ /sems can yongs su smin bya sangs rgyas zhing sbyong ste/ /de yi zhing mchog rgyal sras kun gyis gang 'gyur zhing*/ /rgyal sras rnams dang bsam pa gcig cing don mthun phyir/ /skra sbubs kun tu don gyi dam pa mngon 'tshang rgya/ /de dag smon lam du ma mngon par sgrub par byed/

/de dag mtha' yas yangs shing mthar thug med dang ldan/ /nam mkha'i khams dang chos nyid mya ngan 'das khams dang*/ /'jig rten mthar thug rgyal ba 'byung dang ye shes dang*/ /sems kyis yul dang ye shes 'jug pa'i mthar thug dang*/ /rnam gsum rgyud rnams mthar thug 'gro ba'i mur thug pa/ /rnam pa de tshul bdag smon mtha' yang thug gyur cing*/ /de dag mthar thug ji bzhin bdag spyod de 'drar shog /ces gsungs la/ de la smon lam chen po bcu'i sdom ni/ mchod dang dam chos yongs su bzung*/ /kun 'gro'i lus dang spyod pa dang*/ /yongs su smin dang zhing sbyong dang*/ /sbyangs pa'i zhing de'i khyad par sgrub/ /rgyal sras kun dang mthun par spyod/ /mthun pa'i don 'grub mngon 'tshang rgya/ /de ltar smon lam bcu po la/ /mthar thug gnas kyang rnam bcu ste/ /sems can 'jig rten nam mkha' dang*/ /chos dbyings myang 'das sangs rgyas 'byung*/ /ye shes khams dang sems kyi dmigs/ /ye shes mngon sgrub khams mthar thug /rgyud gsum khams par smon lam 'debs/ /'jig rten chos dang ye shes kyi/ /rgyud de skabs 'dir rgyud gsum mo/ /smon lam chen po bcu ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par smon pa ni dang po'o/ /dam pa'i chos thams cad yongs su bzung zhing bsrung bar smon pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams mdzad pa ngo mtshar can mdzad pa thams cad kyi drung du thogs pa med pa'i lus kyis bdag 'gro zhing bya ba khyad par can byed par smon pa ni gsum pa'o/ /rtag tu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad spyod par smon pa ni bzhi pa'o/ /bdag gi sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed par smon pa ni lnga pa'o/ /'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i zhing 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa 'grub par smon pa ni drug pa'o/ /mngon par sgrub pa'i zhing khams rnams kyang mtha' yas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod yul can las/

byang chub sems dpa' mchog gis gang ba sogs dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu sbyong bar smon pa ni bdun pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang bdag nyid bsam sbyor gcig par smon pa ni brgyad pa'o/ /spyod pa dang nyams len thams cad don gyi mchog kho na mtha' yas pa 'grub par smon pa ni dgu pa'o/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad du mdzad pa mtha' yas pa ston pa'i tshul gyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar smon pa ni bcu pa'o/ /de las dang po mchod pa ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i ched dang*/ gnyis pa dam chos yongs su bzung ba ni/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyi ched du'o/ /gsum pa la sogs pa lnga ni sems can yongs su smin pa'i ched du yin te/ gsum pa kun tu 'gro ba'i lus ni/ rten lus kyi khyad par ci 'dra bas dang*/ bzhi pa spyod pa mtha' dag la slob pa ni/ sems la sogs pa'i spyod pa ci 'dra bas gzhan smin par byed pa dang*/ lnga pa ni/ smin par byed pa dngos te/ gang smin par bya ba'i sems can gyi dbang du byas pa dang*/ drug pa ni/ gnas gang du smin par byed pa'i zhing khams sgrub pa dang*/ bdun pa ni/ rnam pa ji lta bus smin par 'gyur ba'i thabs ston pa'i phyir ro/ /brgyad pa sems dpa' kun dang mthun par spyod pa ni/ rang gi sa'i yon tan gyi khyad par rtogs pa'i phyir dang*/ dgu pa don yod par spyod pa ni/ khyad par rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'gro ba'i phyir dang*/ bcu pa byang chub kyi smon lam ni 'bras bu mthar thug gi phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i smon lam bcu po de yang*/ bzang po spyod pa 'di la yongs su rdzogs par tshang pa yin te/ 'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par gyur/ ces dang*/ de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi/ /zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing*/ /zhes pa la sogs pas dang po'i dbang du byas te sangs rgyas mchod pa'o/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing*/

/zhes dang*/ byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing*/ /zhes rang gis spyod pa dang*/ byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed/ /ces gzhan la ston pa ste/ de sogs mang po zhig ni gnyis pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ dam chos yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /byang chub spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*/ zhes dang*/ rtag tu de dag gi ni spyod yul la/ /sgyu mar gyur pa'i rnam thar stobs kyis 'jug /ces pa la sogs pas ni gsum pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ kun tu 'gro ba'i lus kyis sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul lta ba'o/ /bzang po spyod pa rnam par sbyang ba yang*/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyad par bgyi/ /zhes sogs mang po zhig ni/ bzhi pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ spyod pa thams cad la bslab pa'o/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing*/ /zhes sogs dang*/ sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par grol/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ni/ lnga pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'o/ /de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rgyal ba bdag gi zhing rnams bkod la 'jug /ces pa la sogs pa drug pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ zhing mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'o/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhing der bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams/ /zhes pa nas/ mya ngan 'das pa zhi mtha' rab tu ston/ /ces pa'i bar dang*/ zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*/ /zhes pas ni/ bdun pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ zhing rnam par dag par sbyong ba'o/ /gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yis/ /byang chub spyod pa'i smon lam bye brag rnams/ /zhes sogs dang*/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing*/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag 'phrul pa thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bdag gi spyod dang mtshungs par gang spyod pa/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum dang*/ dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge gang*/ /zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/

tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba na/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ni brgyad pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang spyod pa mthun par spyod pa'o/ /kun tu yon tan spyod pa'i stobs rnams dang*/ /zhes dang*/ spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing*/ /zhes dang*/ yon tan rnams kyang tshad gzung med par shog /ces dang*/ de yi bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mang po dag ni dgu pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ 'bras bu don yod pa kho nar spyad pa'o/ /bzang po spyod pas byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /zhes pa dang*/ skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi/ /sogs dang*/ yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod gyur cig /ces pa dang*/ kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang*/ /zhes dang*/ chags pa med par gyur pa'i ye shes stobs/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ni/ bcu pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par mdzad pa mtha' yas pa bstan pa'i sangs rgyas su smon pa'o/ /smon lam de rnams kyi mthar thug pa'i gnas bcu la/ sems can gyi khams kyi mthar thug pa ni/ sems can ji tsam yod pa'i sa phyogs su smon lam gyis khyab cing*/ ma 'ongs pa na sems can ma zad kyi bar du smon lam gyi 'bras bu yang mi zad pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams dang*/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug pa yang de dang 'dra ste/ 'jig rten dang nam mkhas khyab tshad kyi yul dang*/ de gnyis ji srid yod pa'i bar gyi dus de dag tu smon lam mi zad pa'o/ /gzhan rnams la'ang mthar thug tshul de kho na bzhin yin la/ chos kyi dbyings dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i khams dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi khams rnams ngo bo gcig ste/ ngo bo chos dbyings sems nyid bde bar bshegs pa'i snying po yin la/ 'on kyang 'dul ba'i don du chos ston pa'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings dang*/ mthar thug sems can gang du 'dul ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir mya ngan las 'das pa dang*/

de bzhin nyid dang rnam pa mthun par sgom pa'i chos kyi dmigs pa yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi khams zhes bstan pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i khams dang*/ ye shes mngon par sgrub pa'i khams kyang don gcig ste/ ngo bo ni lam gyi bden pa yin te/ 'bras bu'i dbang du byas nas sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang*/ ngo bo'i dbang du byas nas ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa'o/ /sems kyi dmigs pa'i khams ni shes bya thams cad do/ /rgyud gsum la 'jig rten gyi rgyud ni/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung ngo*/ /chos kyi rgyud ni 'gog pa'i bden pa'o/ /ye shes kyi rgyud ni lam gyi bden pa ste/ de dag ji srid yod kyi bar du/ smon lam 'di'i 'bras bu yod par gyur cig pa'o/ /de ltar na smon lam bcu po yang*/ mthar thug pa'i gnas rnam pa bcu'i sgo nas 'debs dgos pa las/ de yang*/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyu pa/ /bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la 'dus pa yin no/ /smon lam bcu po 'di dag rgyas par 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ sa dang po'i rgyas bshad kyi skabs na yod la/ zhib mor shes 'dod na mdo de nyid dang*/ rgyal sras chen po 'phags pa dbyig gnyen gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa las rtogs par bya la/ rgyas bshad kyi mdo'i tshig dang*/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi tshig phal cher zhib tu sbyor rgyu yod mod kyis/ 'dir ni ha cang mang bar gyur gyi dogs pas ma bkod do/ /phyis byung ba mkhas par rlom pa kha cig gis/ smon lam chen po bcu'i tshigs bcad sbyor ba mthong ste/ des ni mdo rtsa 'grel ma mthong zhing*/ bzang po spyod pa don la sbyor tshul yang ma go bas/ ming tsam las don ma rtogs pa'i bzhad gad kyi gnas kyang snang ngo*/ /de bas na rgyal sras kyi smon lam thams cad smon lam chen po grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcur 'dus la/

de yang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam du 'dus par shes nas/ rtag tu 'di nyid khyad par bzhi dang ldan pas kha ton du byed pa la brtson par bya ste/ theg pa chen po la rnal 'byor du byed pa rnams kyis so/ /'phags pa bzang po spyod pa smon lam gyi rgyal po'i rgya cher 'grel pa/ 'phags mchog rnams kyi gsang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo nang du smras pa'o/ /las dang po la phan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya lnga yi mdo rnams la/ /rnam bshad shin tu go sla shing*/ /zab mo'i don dang ldan par sbyar/ /'di las dge ba gang thob des/ /'gro ba kun gyis chos kyi sku/ /mtha' yas snying po nges thob nas/ /ye shes rgya mtshor ro gcig gyur/ /bkra shis// //
